lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Good evening! Welcome to our restaurant. Are you ready to order?
lines.indonesian: Selamat malam! Selamat datang di restoran kami. Apakah Anda sudah siap memesan?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, I think so. What would you recommend tonight?
lines.indonesian: Ya, sepertinya begitu. Apa yang Anda rekomendasikan malam ini?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Our grilled chicken with herbs is very popular with guests.
lines.indonesian: Ayam panggang dengan bumbu rempah kami sangat populer di kalangan tamu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That sounds great. I'd like the grilled chicken, please.
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya enak. Saya mau pesan ayam panggang itu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Great choice. Would you like any side dishes with that?
lines.indonesian: Pilihan yang bagus. Apakah Anda mau lauk pendamping?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Can I have some steamed vegetables and rice on the side?
lines.indonesian: Boleh minta sayur kukus dan nasi sebagai pendamping?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Of course. And what would you like to drink with your meal?
lines.indonesian: Tentu. Dan minuman apa yang Anda mau untuk menemani makanan Anda?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Just water for now, thank you very much.
lines.indonesian: Air putih saja dulu, terima kasih banyak.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Alright, your order will be ready in about fifteen minutes.
lines.indonesian: Baik, pesanan Anda akan siap dalam sekitar lima belas menit.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That's perfect. Could you also bring some bread while we wait?
lines.indonesian: Itu bagus. Bisa juga bawakan roti sementara kami menunggu?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Absolutely, I'll bring that right away for you.
lines.indonesian: Tentu saja, saya akan segera bawakan itu untuk Anda.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you so much for taking care of us tonight.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih banyak sudah melayani kami malam ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: It's my pleasure. Please let me know if you need anything else.
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama. Tolong beri tahu saya jika Anda butuh yang lain.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I will, thank you again for your kindness tonight.
lines.indonesian: Akan saya lakukan, terima kasih lagi atas kebaikannya malam ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: You're most welcome. I hope you enjoy your meal.
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama. Semoga Anda menikmati makanannya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Excuse me, do you have any halal options on the menu?
lines.indonesian: Permisi, apakah ada menu halal di sini?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, we have a few dishes marked with a special symbol.
lines.indonesian: Ya, ada beberapa menu yang ditandai dengan simbol khusus.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's helpful. Which dishes would you personally recommend?
lines.indonesian: Itu membantu sekali. Menu mana yang Anda rekomendasikan secara pribadi?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: The grilled fish and the chicken curry are both very popular.
lines.indonesian: Ikan panggang dan kari ayam keduanya sangat populer.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Does the chicken curry contain any alcohol in the sauce?
lines.indonesian: Apakah kari ayam ini mengandung alkohol di sausnya?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: No, that dish is completely alcohol-free, I can assure you.
lines.indonesian: Tidak, menu itu sepenuhnya bebas alkohol, saya bisa pastikan itu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's good to hear. I'll have the chicken curry, please.
lines.indonesian: Baguslah kalau begitu. Saya pesan kari ayam saja.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Excellent choice. Would you like it mild or spicy?
lines.indonesian: Pilihan yang bagus. Anda mau yang ringan atau pedas?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Medium spicy would be perfect for me, thank you.
lines.indonesian: Pedas sedang cocok sekali untuk saya, terima kasih.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Perfect. Would you also like some rice or naan bread with it?
lines.indonesian: Sempurna. Apakah Anda juga mau nasi atau roti naan untuk menemaninya?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Rice, please, and maybe a side salad too.
lines.indonesian: Nasi saja, dan mungkin salad kecil juga.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Great, I'll bring your order shortly, please wait a moment.
lines.indonesian: Baik, saya akan bawakan pesanan Anda sebentar lagi, mohon tunggu sebentar.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Sure, no rush at all. Take your time.
lines.indonesian: Baik, tidak buru-buru. Santai saja.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you for your patience, I really appreciate it.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih atas kesabarannya, saya sangat menghargainya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Excuse me, I think there's a mistake with my order.
lines.indonesian: Permisi, sepertinya ada kesalahan dengan pesanan saya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'm sorry to hear that. What seems to be the problem?
lines.indonesian: Maaf mendengarnya. Apa masalahnya?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I ordered the beef soup, but this looks like chicken soup.
lines.indonesian: Saya pesan sup daging, tapi ini terlihat seperti sup ayam.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Let me check your order again in our system right now.
lines.indonesian: Saya cek lagi pesanan Anda di sistem kami sekarang.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you, I appreciate you looking into this quickly.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, saya menghargai Anda menanganinya dengan cepat.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You're right, I apologize for the mix-up in the kitchen.
lines.indonesian: Anda benar, saya minta maaf atas kesalahan di dapur.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: It's alright, mistakes can happen sometimes.
lines.indonesian: Tidak apa-apa, kesalahan bisa saja terjadi.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'll get the correct dish prepared for you right away.
lines.indonesian: Saya akan segera siapkan hidangan yang benar untuk Anda.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you, I really appreciate your quick response.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, saya sangat menghargai tanggapan cepat Anda.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course, and it's on the house for the inconvenience.
lines.indonesian: Tentu, dan ini gratis sebagai permintaan maaf.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's very generous of you, thank you so much.
lines.indonesian: Itu sangat baik dari Anda, terima kasih banyak.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: It's the least we can do. I'll bring the beef soup shortly.
lines.indonesian: Ini yang paling bisa kami lakukan. Saya akan bawakan sup daging sebentar lagi.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I appreciate that, I'll wait patiently for it.
lines.indonesian: Saya menghargainya, saya akan tunggu dengan sabar.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you for understanding, it won't happen again.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih atas pengertiannya, ini tidak akan terjadi lagi.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Hi, I just placed an order. How long will the delivery take?
lines.indonesian: Halo, saya baru saja pesan. Berapa lama pengirimannya?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: It should arrive within thirty minutes, ma'am.
lines.indonesian: Seharusnya sampai dalam tiga puluh menit, Bu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Could you leave it at the front door? I'm in a meeting right now.
lines.indonesian: Bisa tolong ditaruh di depan pintu? Saya sedang rapat sekarang.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sure, no problem. I'll send a message once it's delivered.
lines.indonesian: Baik, tidak masalah. Saya akan kirim pesan setelah diantar.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That would be great, thank you for understanding.
lines.indonesian: Itu bagus sekali, terima kasih atas pengertiannya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course. By the way, do you have any specific instructions?
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama. Ngomong-ngomong, apakah ada instruksi khusus?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Just please make sure the food stays warm if possible.
lines.indonesian: Tolong pastikan makanannya tetap hangat kalau bisa.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'll make sure of that. I'm almost at your location now.
lines.indonesian: Saya akan pastikan itu. Saya hampir sampai di lokasi Anda sekarang.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Wonderful, thank you so much for your help.
lines.indonesian: Bagus sekali, terima kasih banyak atas bantuannya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You're welcome. I've just arrived and left it by your door.
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama. Saya baru saja tiba dan menaruhnya di depan pintu Anda.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Perfect timing, I just finished my meeting too.
lines.indonesian: Waktunya pas sekali, saya juga baru selesai rapat.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Great, I hope you enjoy your meal.
lines.indonesian: Bagus, semoga Anda menikmati makanannya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I'm sure I will, thanks again for the delivery.
lines.indonesian: Saya yakin akan menikmatinya, terima kasih lagi atas pengirimannya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You're welcome. Have a great day and enjoy your meal!
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama. Semoga harimu menyenangkan dan selamat menikmati makanannya!

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Good afternoon, thank you for calling. How can I help you?
lines.indonesian: Selamat siang, terima kasih sudah menelepon. Ada yang bisa saya bantu?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'd like to reserve a table for four people this Saturday evening.
lines.indonesian: Saya mau reservasi meja untuk empat orang Sabtu malam ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Certainly. What time would you prefer for your reservation?
lines.indonesian: Baik. Jam berapa yang Anda inginkan untuk reservasinya?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Around seven o'clock would be perfect for us.
lines.indonesian: Sekitar jam tujuh malam sangat pas untuk kami.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Great, may I have your name for the reservation, please?
lines.indonesian: Baik, boleh minta nama untuk reservasinya?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, it's under the name Fauzan.
lines.indonesian: Ya, atas nama Fauzan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you. Do you have any seating preference, indoor or outdoor?
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih. Apakah Anda punya preferensi tempat duduk, di dalam atau luar?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Indoor would be better, since it's usually cooler.
lines.indonesian: Di dalam lebih baik, karena biasanya lebih sejuk.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Understood. I've reserved an indoor table for you on Saturday at seven.
lines.indonesian: Mengerti. Saya sudah reservasi meja di dalam untuk Anda Sabtu jam tujuh.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Perfect, thank you very much for arranging that.
lines.indonesian: Sempurna, terima kasih banyak sudah mengaturnya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: You're welcome. Is there a special occasion we should prepare for?
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama. Apakah ada acara khusus yang perlu kami siapkan?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, actually, it's a small birthday celebration for a family member.
lines.indonesian: Ya, sebenarnya ini perayaan kecil untuk anggota keluarga.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Wonderful, we can prepare a small dessert for the occasion.
lines.indonesian: Bagus sekali, kami bisa siapkan makanan penutup kecil untuk acara itu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That would be lovely, thank you for the kind gesture.
lines.indonesian: Itu akan menyenangkan, terima kasih atas kebaikannya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Should we split the bill, or do you want to pay separately?
lines.indonesian: Kita bagi bill-nya, atau mau bayar sendiri-sendiri?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Let's just split it evenly, it's easier for both of us.
lines.indonesian: Bagi rata saja, lebih gampang untuk kita berdua.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Sounds good. I'll ask the waiter for two separate checks then.
lines.indonesian: Oke. Saya minta ke pelayan untuk dua struk terpisah kalau begitu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Actually, one bill is fine, we can just transfer each other later.
lines.indonesian: Sebenarnya satu struk saja tidak apa, nanti kita transfer aja.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Okay, that works too. I'll pay first this time.
lines.indonesian: Oke, itu juga bisa. Saya bayar duluan kali ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Are you sure? I don't want you to cover it all.
lines.indonesian: Kamu yakin? Saya tidak mau kamu tanggung semuanya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Don't worry, you can just transfer your half tonight.
lines.indonesian: Jangan khawatir, kamu tinggal transfer bagianmu malam ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Alright, thank you for offering to handle it.
lines.indonesian: Baik, terima kasih sudah menawarkan untuk menanganinya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: No problem at all, this happens all the time between friends.
lines.indonesian: Tidak masalah sama sekali, ini biasa terjadi antar teman.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: True, I really appreciate having friends like you.
lines.indonesian: Benar, saya sangat bersyukur punya teman seperti kamu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Same here, let's do this again sometime soon.
lines.indonesian: Sama, ayo kita lakukan ini lagi suatu saat nanti.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Definitely, maybe next week if we're both free.
lines.indonesian: Pasti, mungkin minggu depan kalau kita berdua sama-sama luang.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Sounds like a plan, I'll message you later this week.
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya cocok, saya akan kabari kamu nanti minggu ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Hi there, what can I get started for you today?
lines.indonesian: Halo, mau pesan apa hari ini?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Can I get a medium latte with less sugar, please?
lines.indonesian: Boleh minta latte ukuran sedang dengan gula lebih sedikit?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Sure. Would you like that hot or iced today?
lines.indonesian: Baik. Mau yang panas atau dingin hari ini?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Iced, please. And can you use oat milk instead of regular milk?
lines.indonesian: Yang dingin. Dan bisa pakai susu oat, bukan susu biasa?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: No problem at all. Would you like any flavor added?
lines.indonesian: Tidak masalah sama sekali. Anda mau tambahan rasa tertentu?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: A little vanilla syrup would be nice, actually.
lines.indonesian: Sedikit sirup vanila sepertinya enak juga.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Got it. That'll be ready in a few minutes.
lines.indonesian: Baik. Akan siap dalam beberapa menit.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Great, and could I also get a small pastry to go with it?
lines.indonesian: Baik, dan bisa saya juga pesan kue kecil untuk menemaninya?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Of course, we have croissants and muffins available today.
lines.indonesian: Tentu, kami punya croissant dan muffin tersedia hari ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'll take a croissant, thank you very much.
lines.indonesian: Saya ambil croissant, terima kasih banyak.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Sure thing. Will that be for here or to go?
lines.indonesian: Baik. Untuk makan di sini atau dibawa pulang?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: To go, please, I'm heading to work right after this.
lines.indonesian: Dibawa pulang, saya mau langsung ke kantor setelah ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Understood, I'll have it packed for you shortly.
lines.indonesian: Mengerti, saya akan bungkuskan sebentar lagi untuk Anda.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you, I appreciate the quick service.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, saya menghargai pelayanan yang cepat ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Good morning, this is City Clinic. How may I help you?
lines.indonesian: Selamat pagi, ini City Clinic. Ada yang bisa saya bantu?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'd like to make an appointment with Dr. Rahman this week.
lines.indonesian: Saya mau buat janji dengan Dr. Rahman minggu ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Sure, may I know the reason for your visit first?
lines.indonesian: Baik, boleh saya tahu alasan kunjungan Anda terlebih dahulu?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I've been having frequent headaches for the past week.
lines.indonesian: Saya sering sakit kepala selama seminggu terakhir.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I see. He has an opening on Wednesday at ten in the morning.
lines.indonesian: Begitu. Ada jadwal kosong hari Rabu jam sepuluh pagi.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, that works perfectly for me.
lines.indonesian: Ya, itu sangat cocok untuk saya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Great, may I have your full name and phone number?
lines.indonesian: Baik, boleh minta nama lengkap dan nomor telepon Anda?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sure, it's Siti Aminah, and my number is 0812-3456-7890.
lines.indonesian: Tentu, Siti Aminah, dan nomor saya 0812-3456-7890.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you. Please arrive fifteen minutes before your appointment.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih. Mohon datang lima belas menit sebelum jadwal Anda.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Understood, I'll make sure to be on time.
lines.indonesian: Mengerti, saya akan pastikan tepat waktu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Also, please bring your insurance card if you have one.
lines.indonesian: Selain itu, tolong bawa kartu asuransi Anda kalau punya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, I have one, I'll bring it along.
lines.indonesian: Ya, saya punya, saya akan bawa itu juga.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Perfect, we'll see you on Wednesday then.
lines.indonesian: Sempurna, sampai jumpa hari Rabu kalau begitu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you very much for your help today.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih banyak atas bantuannya hari ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Good morning. What brings you in today?
lines.indonesian: Selamat pagi. Ada keluhan apa hari ini?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I've had a fever and a sore throat for the past two days.
lines.indonesian: Saya demam dan sakit tenggorokan sejak dua hari lalu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Have you noticed any other symptoms, like coughing or body aches?
lines.indonesian: Apakah ada gejala lain, seperti batuk atau nyeri badan?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, I've also had a mild headache since yesterday.
lines.indonesian: Ya, saya juga sedikit sakit kepala sejak kemarin.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I see. Have you taken any medicine so far?
lines.indonesian: Begitu. Apakah Anda sudah minum obat sejauh ini?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Just some paracetamol, but it only helps a little.
lines.indonesian: Cuma parasetamol, tapi hanya sedikit membantu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Alright, let me check your temperature and throat first.
lines.indonesian: Baik, saya periksa suhu dan tenggorokan Anda dulu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Alright, thank you, doctor.
lines.indonesian: Baik, terima kasih, Dokter.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Your throat looks a bit inflamed, but nothing too serious.
lines.indonesian: Tenggorokan Anda terlihat agak meradang, tapi tidak terlalu serius.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That's a relief. What should I do to recover faster?
lines.indonesian: Melegakan sekali. Apa yang harus saya lakukan supaya cepat sembuh?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Get plenty of rest and drink warm water throughout the day.
lines.indonesian: Istirahat yang cukup dan minum air hangat sepanjang hari.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Should I take any antibiotics for this?
lines.indonesian: Apakah saya perlu minum antibiotik untuk ini?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Not yet, this seems viral, so rest should be enough for now.
lines.indonesian: Belum perlu, ini sepertinya virus, jadi istirahat saja sudah cukup untuk sekarang.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Understood, thank you for the clear advice.
lines.indonesian: Mengerti, terima kasih atas sarannya yang jelas.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Good afternoon, how can I help you?
lines.indonesian: Selamat siang, ada yang bisa saya bantu?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'd like to fill this prescription, please.
lines.indonesian: Saya mau menebus resep ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Sure, give me a moment to check the stock for you.
lines.indonesian: Baik, saya cek stoknya sebentar untuk Anda.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Take your time, I'll wait here.
lines.indonesian: Silakan santai saja, saya tunggu di sini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Good news, we have everything on your prescription in stock.
lines.indonesian: Kabar baik, semua obat di resep Anda tersedia.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Great. Does this medicine have any side effects I should know about?
lines.indonesian: Baik. Apakah obat ini punya efek samping yang perlu saya ketahui?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: It may cause slight drowsiness, so avoid driving after taking it.
lines.indonesian: Bisa menyebabkan sedikit kantuk, jadi hindari berkendara setelah minum ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Understood, thank you for letting me know.
lines.indonesian: Mengerti, terima kasih sudah memberi tahu saya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: You're welcome. Take it after meals, twice a day.
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama. Minum setelah makan, dua kali sehari.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Got it, I'll follow the instructions carefully.
lines.indonesian: Baik, saya akan ikuti instruksinya dengan hati-hati.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Also, please finish the full course even if you feel better.
lines.indonesian: Selain itu, tolong habiskan obatnya walaupun sudah merasa lebih baik.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Okay, I understand the importance of that.
lines.indonesian: Baik, saya mengerti pentingnya itu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Great, here's your medicine, and get well soon.
lines.indonesian: Baik, ini obat Anda, dan semoga lekas sembuh.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you so much for your help and advice.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih banyak atas bantuan dan sarannya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Please have a seat. What seems to be the issue today?
lines.indonesian: Silakan duduk. Ada masalah apa hari ini?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I've had a sharp pain in my lower tooth for a few days.
lines.indonesian: Gigi bawah saya nyeri tajam sejak beberapa hari.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Let me take a look. Does it hurt when you bite down?
lines.indonesian: Saya periksa dulu. Apakah sakit saat Anda mengunyah?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, especially when I eat something cold or sweet.
lines.indonesian: Ya, terutama saat makan sesuatu yang dingin atau manis.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: It looks like a small cavity has formed there.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Is it something that needs to be treated right away?
lines.indonesian: Apakah ini perlu segera diobati?

lines.indonesian: Ya, sebaiknya kita obati hari ini sebelum semakin parah.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Alright, thank you for explaining everything clearly.
lines.indonesian: Baik, terima kasih sudah menjelaskan semuanya dengan jelas.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Of course. Will you feel a little numbness after the treatment?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That's fine, I just want the pain to stop.
lines.indonesian: Tidak masalah, saya cuma ingin rasa sakitnya berhenti.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Understood, we'll take good care of it right away.
lines.indonesian: Mengerti, kami akan segera menanganinya dengan baik.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you, I feel more relaxed now.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, saya merasa lebih tenang sekarang.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Hello, how has your child been feeling lately?
lines.indonesian: Halo, bagaimana kondisi anak Anda akhir-akhir ini?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: She's been eating well, but she's had a mild cough for a few days.
lines.indonesian: Dia makan dengan baik, tapi sudah beberapa hari batuk ringan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Has she had any fever along with the cough?
lines.indonesian: Apakah ada demam yang menyertai batuknya?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: No fever, just the cough, mostly at night.
lines.indonesian: Tidak demam, hanya batuk, terutama malam hari.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I see. Is she still active and playing normally?
lines.indonesian: Begitu. Apakah dia masih aktif dan bermain seperti biasa?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, she's still very energetic during the day.
lines.indonesian: Ya, dia masih sangat energik di siang hari.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's a good sign. I'll listen to her chest just to be safe.
lines.indonesian: Itu tanda yang bagus. Saya akan periksa dadanya untuk berjaga-jaga.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you, doctor. I appreciate your care.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, Dokter. Saya sangat menghargai perhatiannya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Her lungs sound clear, so no medicine is needed for now.
lines.indonesian: Paru-parunya terdengar bersih, jadi belum perlu obat untuk saat ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That's a relief to hear, thank you so much.
lines.indonesian: Melegakan sekali mendengarnya, terima kasih banyak.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Just make sure she stays hydrated and gets enough rest.
lines.indonesian: Pastikan saja dia cukup minum air dan istirahat yang cukup.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I will make sure of that at home.
lines.indonesian: Saya akan pastikan itu di rumah.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: If the cough continues past a week, bring her back to see me.
lines.indonesian: Kalau batuknya berlanjut lebih dari seminggu, bawa dia kembali ke sini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Understood, I'll keep an eye on it closely.
lines.indonesian: Mengerti, saya akan pantau dengan seksama.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you for calling. How may I assist you today?
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih sudah menelepon. Ada yang bisa saya bantu?

lines.english: May I have your policy number, please?

lines.english: Thank you. I can see your claim is currently being processed.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Alright, how long will the processing usually take?
lines.indonesian: Baik, biasanya berapa lama prosesnya?

lines.english: Okay, please stay calm. What's your exact address?
lines.indonesian: Baik, tolong tetap tenang. Apa alamat lengkap Anda?

lines.speaker: B

lines.indonesian: Baik, saya bayar pakai e-wallet kalau begitu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sure, please scan this code to complete your payment.
lines.indonesian: Baik, silakan pindai kode ini untuk menyelesaikan pembayaran Anda.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Good morning, may I see your passport and ticket, please?
lines.indonesian: Selamat pagi, boleh lihat paspor dan tiket Anda?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Here you go. I'd also like a window seat if possible.
lines.indonesian: Ini dia. Saya juga mau kursi dekat jendela kalau bisa.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Let me check availability. Yes, I can arrange that for you.
lines.indonesian: Saya cek ketersediaannya. Ya, saya bisa aturkan untuk Anda.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you. How many bags am I allowed to check in?
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih. Berapa banyak koper yang boleh saya check-in?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: You're allowed two bags, up to twenty-three kilos each.
lines.indonesian: Anda boleh bawa dua koper, masing-masing hingga dua puluh tiga kilo.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Great, I only have one, so that's fine.
lines.indonesian: Baik, saya cuma bawa satu, jadi tidak masalah.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Perfect. Please place your bag on the scale over there.
lines.indonesian: Sempurna. Silakan letakkan koper Anda di timbangan itu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sure, here it is. Is the weight okay?
lines.indonesian: Baik, ini dia. Apakah beratnya sudah pas?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Yes, that's within the limit. Here's your boarding pass.
lines.indonesian: Ya, itu masih di dalam batas. Ini boarding pass Anda.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you very much, which gate should I go to?
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih banyak, saya harus ke gerbang mana?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Gate twelve, boarding starts in about an hour.
lines.indonesian: Gerbang dua belas, boarding dimulai sekitar satu jam lagi.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Alright, is there a prayer room near that gate?
lines.indonesian: Baik, apakah ada mushola dekat gerbang itu?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Yes, there's one just before you reach the gate.
lines.indonesian: Ya, ada satu tepat sebelum Anda sampai ke gerbangnya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Perfect, thank you for all the information.
lines.indonesian: Sempurna, terima kasih atas semua informasinya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Good afternoon. What's the purpose of your visit?
lines.indonesian: Selamat siang. Apa tujuan kunjungan Anda?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'm here for a family vacation, staying about ten days.
lines.indonesian: Saya di sini untuk liburan keluarga, sekitar sepuluh hari.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Where will you be staying during your visit?
lines.indonesian: Anda akan menginap di mana selama kunjungan?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: At a hotel near the city center, I have the booking here.
lines.indonesian: Di hotel dekat pusat kota, saya punya bukti pemesanannya di sini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you. Are you traveling alone or with family?
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih. Apakah Anda bepergian sendiri atau bersama keluarga?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: With my wife and two children, they're right behind me.
lines.indonesian: Bersama istri dan dua anak saya, mereka tepat di belakang saya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I see. Do you have a return flight already booked?
lines.indonesian: Begitu. Apakah Anda sudah memesan tiket pulang?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, it's scheduled for ten days from now.
lines.indonesian: Ya, dijadwalkan sepuluh hari dari sekarang.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you. Do you have enough funds for your stay?
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih. Apakah Anda punya cukup dana untuk tinggal di sini?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, I have my bank statement and cash with me.
lines.indonesian: Ya, saya bawa rekening koran dan uang tunai.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Good, that's all I need. Enjoy your stay.
lines.indonesian: Baik, itu semua yang saya perlukan. Semoga kunjungannya menyenangkan.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you very much, officer.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih banyak, Pak/Bu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Welcome to our country, have a pleasant trip.
lines.indonesian: Selamat datang di negara kami, semoga perjalanannya menyenangkan.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you, I'm looking forward to it.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, saya sangat menantikannya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Welcome! Do you have a reservation with us?
lines.indonesian: Selamat datang! Apakah Anda punya reservasi dengan kami?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, under the name Hidayat, for two nights.
lines.indonesian: Ya, atas nama Hidayat, untuk dua malam.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Found it. May I see your ID and a credit card for deposit?
lines.indonesian: Ketemu. Boleh minta ID Anda dan kartu kredit untuk deposit?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Here they are. Also, is breakfast included?
lines.indonesian: Ini dia. Selain itu, apakah sarapan sudah termasuk?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Yes, breakfast is served from six to ten in the morning.
lines.indonesian: Ya, sarapan disajikan dari jam enam hingga sepuluh pagi.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Perfect, thank you for the information.
lines.indonesian: Sempurna, terima kasih informasinya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: You're welcome. Your room is on the fifth floor, room 512.
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama. Kamar Anda ada di lantai lima, kamar 512.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Great, is there a prayer room available in the hotel?
lines.indonesian: Baik, apakah ada mushola tersedia di hotel ini?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Yes, it's located on the ground floor near the elevator.
lines.indonesian: Ya, letaknya di lantai dasar dekat lift.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Wonderful, thank you so much for your help.
lines.indonesian: Bagus sekali, terima kasih banyak atas bantuannya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Do you need any help carrying your luggage to the room?
lines.indonesian: Apakah Anda butuh bantuan membawa koper ke kamar?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, please, that would be very helpful.
lines.indonesian: Ya, tolong, itu akan sangat membantu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: No problem, our staff will assist you right away.
lines.indonesian: Tidak masalah, staf kami akan segera membantu Anda.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you for such wonderful hospitality.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih atas keramahan yang luar biasa ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Hello, the air conditioner in my room isn't working.
lines.indonesian: Halo, AC di kamar saya tidak berfungsi.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'm sorry for the trouble. I'll send someone to check it right away.
lines.indonesian: Mohon maaf atas ketidaknyamanannya. Saya akan kirim orang untuk cek segera.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you. Also, could I get extra towels?
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih. Selain itu, bisa minta handuk tambahan?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course, I'll have them sent up along with the technician.
lines.indonesian: Tentu, saya akan kirimkan bersama teknisinya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I appreciate that. How long will the repair take?
lines.indonesian: Saya menghargai itu. Berapa lama perbaikannya?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: It shouldn't take more than thirty minutes.
lines.indonesian: Seharusnya tidak lebih dari tiga puluh menit.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Alright, is there somewhere I can wait meanwhile?
lines.indonesian: Baik, apakah ada tempat saya bisa tunggu sementara itu?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You're welcome to relax in our lobby lounge nearby.
lines.indonesian: Anda dipersilakan bersantai di lounge lobi kami di dekat sini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Sounds good, thank you for accommodating me.
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya bagus, terima kasih sudah membantu saya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: It's our pleasure, we'll notify you once it's fixed.
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama, kami akan beri tahu Anda setelah selesai diperbaiki.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Should I go back to my room, or wait for your message?
lines.indonesian: Apakah saya perlu kembali ke kamar, atau tunggu pesan dari Anda?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Please wait here, we'll come find you once it's ready.
lines.indonesian: Tolong tunggu di sini, kami akan mencari Anda setelah siap.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Understood, I'll be right here in the lounge.
lines.indonesian: Mengerti, saya akan berada di sini di lounge.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Perfect, thank you again for your patience.
lines.indonesian: Sempurna, terima kasih lagi atas kesabarannya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Good evening, where would you like to go?
lines.indonesian: Selamat malam, mau ke mana?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: To the central mosque, please. Do you know the way?
lines.indonesian: Ke masjid pusat, tolong. Apakah Anda tahu jalannya?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Yes, I know it well. It'll take about fifteen minutes.
lines.indonesian: Ya, saya tahu jalannya. Kira-kira lima belas menit.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Could you take the route through Sudirman Street? It's usually faster.
lines.indonesian: Bisa lewat Jalan Sudirman? Biasanya lebih cepat.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Sure, no problem at all. Traffic looks light tonight anyway.
lines.indonesian: Baik, tidak masalah sama sekali. Lalu lintas juga tampak lancar malam ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That's good to hear. Thank you, I appreciate it.
lines.indonesian: Baguslah kalau begitu. Terima kasih, saya menghargainya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: No problem. Are you attending an event there tonight?
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama. Apakah Anda menghadiri acara di sana malam ini?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, there's a lecture after Isha prayer.
lines.indonesian: Ya, ada kajian setelah shalat Isya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That sounds nice. I'll make sure to get you there in time.
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya bagus. Saya akan pastikan Anda tiba tepat waktu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you very much, I appreciate your effort.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih banyak, saya menghargai usahanya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: We're almost there, just around this next corner.
lines.indonesian: Kita hampir sampai, tinggal belok di tikungan berikutnya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Great, you can drop me off right by the main entrance.
lines.indonesian: Baik, Anda bisa turunkan saya tepat di pintu masuk utama.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Sure thing, here we are, safe and sound.
lines.indonesian: Baik, kita sudah sampai, dengan selamat.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you so much for the smooth ride tonight.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih banyak atas perjalanan yang lancar malam ini.

title: Tanya Arah ke Orang di Jalan

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the train station?
lines.indonesian: Permisi, bisa tolong beri tahu jalan ke stasiun kereta?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sure, go straight for two blocks, then turn left.
lines.indonesian: Tentu, lurus dua blok, lalu belok kiri.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Is it within walking distance from here?
lines.indonesian: Apakah bisa dijangkau dengan jalan kaki dari sini?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, it's about ten minutes on foot.
lines.indonesian: Ya, sekitar sepuluh menit jalan kaki.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Great, is there anything I should watch out for along the way?
lines.indonesian: Baik, apakah ada yang perlu saya perhatikan di sepanjang jalan?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Just be careful crossing the main road, it can be busy.
lines.indonesian: Hati-hati saja saat menyeberang jalan utama, biasanya ramai.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Noted, thank you for the warning.
lines.indonesian: Dicatat, terima kasih atas peringatannya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: No problem, the station has a clear sign once you're close.
lines.indonesian: Tidak masalah, stasiunnya ada tanda yang jelas begitu Anda dekat.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you so much for your help.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih banyak atas bantuannya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You're welcome, safe travels!
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama, hati-hati di jalan!

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Actually, is there a place to buy water nearby too?
lines.indonesian: Sebenarnya, apakah ada tempat beli air minum di dekat sini juga?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, there's a small shop right before the station entrance.
lines.indonesian: Ya, ada toko kecil tepat sebelum pintu masuk stasiun.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Perfect, that's very convenient. Thanks again.
lines.indonesian: Sempurna, itu sangat memudahkan. Terima kasih lagi.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You're very welcome, enjoy the rest of your trip.
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama, selamat melanjutkan perjalanannya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Excuse me, I just missed my flight. What can I do now?
lines.indonesian: Permisi, saya baru saja ketinggalan pesawat. Apa yang bisa saya lakukan?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Don't worry, let's check the next available flight for you.
lines.indonesian: Jangan khawatir, kita cek penerbangan berikutnya yang tersedia.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Will there be an extra charge for rescheduling?
lines.indonesian: Apakah akan ada biaya tambahan untuk reschedule?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: There's a small rebooking fee, but the next flight is in three hours.
lines.indonesian: Ada biaya penjadwalan ulang yang kecil, tapi penerbangan berikutnya tiga jam lagi.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That works for me. Please book me on that flight.
lines.indonesian: Itu cocok untuk saya. Tolong pesankan saya di penerbangan itu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sure, may I see your ticket and ID again, please?
lines.indonesian: Baik, boleh lihat tiket dan ID Anda lagi?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Here you go. I hope this won't happen again.
lines.indonesian: Ini dia. Saya harap ini tidak terjadi lagi.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I understand, we'll make sure you're seated comfortably this time.
lines.indonesian: Saya mengerti, kami akan pastikan Anda duduk dengan nyaman kali ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you, I appreciate your understanding and help.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, saya menghargai pengertian dan bantuannya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You're welcome, here's your new boarding pass.
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama, ini boarding pass baru Anda.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Which gate should I go to this time?
lines.indonesian: Saya harus ke gerbang mana kali ini?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Gate nine, and please arrive there an hour before departure.
lines.indonesian: Gerbang sembilan, dan mohon tiba di sana satu jam sebelum keberangkatan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Understood, I'll head there right away this time.
lines.indonesian: Mengerti, saya akan langsung ke sana kali ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Great, I hope you have a pleasant flight this time.
lines.indonesian: Bagus, semoga penerbangannya menyenangkan kali ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Hi, I'd like to rent a car for five days.
lines.indonesian: Halo, saya mau sewa mobil selama lima hari.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sure, do you prefer an automatic or manual transmission?
lines.indonesian: Baik, Anda lebih suka transmisi otomatis atau manual?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Automatic, please. Does the price include insurance?
lines.indonesian: Otomatis. Apakah harganya sudah termasuk asuransi?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, basic insurance is included in the rental price.
lines.indonesian: Ya, asuransi dasar sudah termasuk dalam harga sewa.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Great, I'll take the sedan then.
lines.indonesian: Baik, saya ambil sedan kalau begitu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Perfect, I just need your driving license and a deposit.
lines.indonesian: Sempurna, saya hanya butuh SIM Anda dan deposit.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Here they are. Is fuel included in the rental?
lines.indonesian: Ini dia. Apakah bahan bakar sudah termasuk dalam sewa?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: No, you'll need to return it with the same fuel level.
lines.indonesian: Tidak, Anda perlu mengembalikannya dengan level bahan bakar yang sama.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Understood, that sounds fair enough.
lines.indonesian: Mengerti, itu terdengar cukup adil.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Great, the car will be ready for you in ten minutes.
lines.indonesian: Baik, mobilnya akan siap untuk Anda dalam sepuluh menit.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you. What should I do if the car breaks down?
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih. Apa yang harus saya lakukan kalau mobilnya mogok?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Just call our hotline, we offer twenty-four hour roadside assistance.
lines.indonesian: Cukup telepon hotline kami, kami sediakan bantuan jalan dua puluh empat jam.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's reassuring to know, thank you.
lines.indonesian: Itu melegakan untuk diketahui, terima kasih.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You're welcome, enjoy your trip and drive safely.
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama, selamat menikmati perjalanan dan berkendara dengan aman.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you for coming in. Can you tell me about yourself?
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih sudah datang. Bisa ceritakan tentang diri Anda?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course. I've worked in marketing for three years, mostly in digital campaigns.
lines.indonesian: Tentu. Saya sudah bekerja di bidang pemasaran selama tiga tahun, terutama kampanye digital.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: What made you interested in this position?
lines.indonesian: Apa yang membuat Anda tertarik dengan posisi ini?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I admire your company's growth, and I want to contribute to that.
lines.indonesian: Saya mengagumi perkembangan perusahaan ini, dan saya ingin berkontribusi.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's great to hear. What would you say is your biggest strength?
lines.indonesian: Bagus sekali mendengarnya. Apa yang Anda anggap sebagai kekuatan terbesar Anda?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'd say adaptability, I learn new tools and processes quickly.
lines.indonesian: Saya rasa kemampuan beradaptasi, saya cepat mempelajari alat dan proses baru.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Good to know. Do you have experience working in a team environment?
lines.indonesian: Baik untuk diketahui. Apakah Anda punya pengalaman bekerja dalam tim?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, I've led a small team on several successful campaigns.
lines.indonesian: Ya, saya pernah memimpin tim kecil dalam beberapa kampanye yang sukses.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Impressive. Do you have any questions for us?
lines.indonesian: Mengesankan. Apakah Anda punya pertanyaan untuk kami?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, what does a typical day look like in this role?
lines.indonesian: Ya, seperti apa hari biasa dalam posisi ini?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: You'll manage campaigns and coordinate with the design team daily.
lines.indonesian: Anda akan mengelola kampanye dan berkoordinasi dengan tim desain setiap hari.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That sounds exciting, exactly the kind of work I enjoy.
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya menarik, persis jenis pekerjaan yang saya sukai.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Great, we'll be in touch within the next few days.
lines.indonesian: Baik, kami akan menghubungi Anda dalam beberapa hari ke depan.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you very much for this opportunity today.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih banyak atas kesempatan hari ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Excuse me, could I request a few days off next week?
lines.indonesian: Permisi, bolehkah saya minta izin cuti beberapa hari minggu depan?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sure, what's the reason for the leave?
lines.indonesian: Baik, apa alasan untuk cutinya?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I need to attend a family event out of town.
lines.indonesian: Saya perlu menghadiri acara keluarga di luar kota.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That's understandable. How many days will you need?
lines.indonesian: Bisa dimengerti. Berapa hari yang Anda butuhkan?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Three days, from Monday to Wednesday.
lines.indonesian: Tiga hari, dari Senin sampai Rabu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Alright, I'll approve that. Just submit the form today.
lines.indonesian: Baik, saya setujui. Tolong ajukan formulirnya hari ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you so much. Should I brief someone on my tasks?
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih banyak. Apakah saya perlu jelaskan tugas saya ke orang lain?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, please hand over your pending work to Aisyah.
lines.indonesian: Ya, tolong serahkan pekerjaan yang belum selesai ke Aisyah.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I'll prepare a handover document before I leave.
lines.indonesian: Saya akan siapkan dokumen serah terima sebelum saya pergi.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That sounds thorough, I appreciate your preparation.
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya menyeluruh, saya menghargai persiapan Anda.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Of course, I want everything to run smoothly while I'm away.
lines.indonesian: Tentu, saya ingin semuanya berjalan lancar selama saya pergi.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Good attitude. Enjoy your time with family.
lines.indonesian: Sikap yang bagus. Selamat menikmati waktu bersama keluarga.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you, I'll see you again the following Thursday.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, sampai jumpa lagi Kamis berikutnya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: See you then, safe travels to you and your family.
lines.indonesian: Sampai jumpa nanti, semoga perjalanan Anda dan keluarga lancar.

title: Small Talk dengan Rekan Kerja Baru

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Hi, I'm new here. I just joined the finance team.
lines.indonesian: Halo, saya baru di sini. Saya baru bergabung dengan tim keuangan.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Welcome aboard! I'm from the operations team, nice to meet you.
lines.indonesian: Selamat bergabung! Saya dari tim operasional, senang berkenalan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Nice to meet you too. How long have you worked here?
lines.indonesian: Senang berkenalan juga. Sudah berapa lama Anda bekerja di sini?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: About four years now. It's a great place to work.
lines.indonesian: Sekitar empat tahun sekarang. Ini tempat kerja yang bagus.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's good to know. Any tips for someone just starting out?
lines.indonesian: Baguslah kalau begitu. Ada tips untuk orang yang baru mulai?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Just ask questions whenever you're unsure, everyone's helpful here.
lines.indonesian: Tanya saja kalau Anda tidak yakin, semua orang di sini suka membantu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's reassuring. Where's a good place to have lunch nearby?
lines.indonesian: Itu melegakan. Di mana tempat makan siang yang bagus di dekat sini?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: There's a nice halal food court just around the corner.
lines.indonesian: Ada foodcourt halal yang bagus tepat di sekitar sudut jalan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Perfect, would you like to grab lunch together sometime?
lines.indonesian: Baik, mau makan siang bareng suatu saat nanti?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sure, how about tomorrow if you're free?
lines.indonesian: Boleh, bagaimana kalau besok kalau kamu luang?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That works for me, I'll come find you around noon.
lines.indonesian: Itu cocok untuk saya, saya akan datang mencarimu sekitar tengah hari.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sounds good, I'll introduce you to a few others too.
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya bagus, saya akan kenalkan kamu ke beberapa orang lain juga.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That would be great, thank you for being so welcoming.
lines.indonesian: Itu akan bagus sekali, terima kasih sudah sangat ramah.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course, we're happy to have you on the team.
lines.indonesian: Tentu, kami senang kamu bergabung dengan tim ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: May I share my thoughts on this proposal?
lines.indonesian: Bolehkah saya menyampaikan pendapat tentang proposal ini?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course, go ahead.
lines.indonesian: Tentu, silakan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I think we should focus more on customer feedback before launching.
lines.indonesian: Saya rasa kita perlu lebih fokus pada masukan pelanggan sebelum meluncurkan.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That's a fair point. What kind of feedback do you suggest we collect?
lines.indonesian: Itu masukan yang bagus. Jenis masukan apa yang Anda sarankan untuk dikumpulkan?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Maybe a short survey with our existing users first.
lines.indonesian: Mungkin survei singkat dengan pengguna kita yang sudah ada dulu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Let's do that. I'll assign someone to set it up.
lines.indonesian: Ayo kita lakukan itu. Saya akan tugaskan seseorang untuk menyiapkannya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I can help design the survey questions if that's useful.
lines.indonesian: Saya bisa bantu merancang pertanyaan surveinya kalau itu berguna.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That would be very helpful, thank you for volunteering.
lines.indonesian: Itu akan sangat membantu, terima kasih sudah menawarkan diri.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: No problem, when do you need the draft ready?
lines.indonesian: Tidak masalah, kapan Anda butuh draftnya siap?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: By Friday would be perfect, so we can review it together.
lines.indonesian: Sampai Jumat sudah pas, supaya kita bisa tinjau bersama.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Understood, I'll have it ready by then.
lines.indonesian: Mengerti, saya akan siapkan sebelum itu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Great, thank you for taking the initiative on this.
lines.indonesian: Baik, terima kasih sudah berinisiatif untuk hal ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: It's my pleasure, I want this launch to succeed.
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama, saya ingin peluncuran ini berhasil.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Same here, let's keep the momentum going.
lines.indonesian: Sama, ayo kita jaga momentumnya tetap berjalan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you for the offer. Is there room to discuss the salary?
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih atas tawarannya. Apakah ada ruang untuk mendiskusikan gaji?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sure, what figure did you have in mind?
lines.indonesian: Tentu, angka berapa yang Anda pikirkan?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Based on my experience, I was hoping for a slightly higher amount.
lines.indonesian: Berdasarkan pengalaman saya, saya berharap angka yang sedikit lebih tinggi.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I understand. Let me check with management and get back to you.
lines.indonesian: Saya mengerti. Saya akan cek dengan manajemen dan kembali ke Anda.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you, I appreciate you considering it.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, saya menghargai Anda mempertimbangkannya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course. Is salary the only concern, or are there other terms?
lines.indonesian: Tentu. Apakah gaji satu-satunya perhatian, atau ada syarat lain?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I'd also like to clarify the remote work policy.
lines.indonesian: Saya juga ingin klarifikasi kebijakan kerja jarak jauh.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: We currently allow two remote days per week.
lines.indonesian: Saat ini kami mengizinkan dua hari kerja jarak jauh per minggu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That sounds reasonable, thank you for clarifying.
lines.indonesian: Itu terdengar masuk akal, terima kasih sudah mengklarifikasi.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'll follow up with the updated offer by tomorrow.
lines.indonesian: Saya akan tindak lanjuti dengan tawaran yang diperbarui besok.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Perfect, I look forward to hearing from you.
lines.indonesian: Sempurna, saya menantikan kabar dari Anda.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Likewise, we're excited about the possibility of you joining.
lines.indonesian: Sama, kami senang dengan kemungkinan Anda bergabung.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you, this has been a very positive conversation.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, ini adalah percakapan yang sangat positif.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Agreed, talk to you again soon.
lines.indonesian: Setuju, sampai jumpa lagi segera.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I wanted to let you know that I've decided to resign.
lines.indonesian: Saya ingin memberi tahu bahwa saya memutuskan untuk mengundurkan diri.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I appreciate you telling me directly. May I ask the reason?
lines.indonesian: Saya menghargai Anda memberi tahu langsung. Boleh tahu alasannya?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I've received an opportunity closer to my hometown.
lines.indonesian: Saya mendapat kesempatan yang lebih dekat dengan kampung halaman saya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That makes sense. When would your last day be?
lines.indonesian: Itu masuk akal. Kapan hari terakhir Anda?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I'd like to give a proper two-week notice.
lines.indonesian: Saya ingin memberi pemberitahuan dua minggu sebagaimana mestinya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you for your professionalism. We'll miss having you here.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih atas profesionalisme Anda. Kami akan merindukan Anda di sini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I've really enjoyed my time working with this team.
lines.indonesian: Saya sangat menikmati waktu saya bekerja dengan tim ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: We've enjoyed having you too. Will you help train your replacement?
lines.indonesian: Kami juga senang punya Anda. Apakah Anda akan membantu melatih pengganti Anda?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Of course, I'll prepare detailed notes on my responsibilities.
lines.indonesian: Tentu, saya akan siapkan catatan detail tentang tanggung jawab saya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That's very considerate of you, thank you.
lines.indonesian: Itu sangat perhatian dari Anda, terima kasih.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: It's the least I can do after all the support I've received.
lines.indonesian: Ini yang paling bisa saya lakukan setelah semua dukungan yang saya terima.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: We wish you all the best in your new opportunity.
lines.indonesian: Kami mendoakan yang terbaik untuk kesempatan baru Anda.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you so much, I truly appreciate that.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih banyak, saya sangat menghargai itu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Let's keep in touch even after you leave.
lines.indonesian: Ayo kita tetap berhubungan bahkan setelah Anda pergi.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I noticed a few errors in the last report you submitted.
lines.indonesian: Saya melihat ada beberapa kesalahan di laporan terakhir yang Anda kirim.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'm sorry about that. Could you point out where I went wrong?
lines.indonesian: Mohon maaf soal itu. Bisa tunjukkan di mana kesalahan saya?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: The sales figures on page two don't match the summary.
lines.indonesian: Angka penjualan di halaman dua tidak cocok dengan ringkasannya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'll double-check the numbers and send a corrected version today.
lines.indonesian: Saya akan periksa ulang angkanya dan kirim versi yang benar hari ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you, I appreciate you taking this seriously.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, saya menghargai Anda menanggapi ini dengan serius.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course, could you also review it once I resend it?
lines.indonesian: Tentu, bisa Anda tinjau lagi setelah saya kirim ulang?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Sure, just send it to me by the end of the day.
lines.indonesian: Baik, kirimkan saja ke saya sebelum akhir hari ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I will. Is there anything else I should be more careful about?
lines.indonesian: Akan saya lakukan. Apakah ada hal lain yang perlu lebih saya perhatikan?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Just make sure to proofread before submitting next time.
lines.indonesian: Pastikan saja untuk memeriksa ulang sebelum mengirim lain kali.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Understood, I'll be more thorough going forward.
lines.indonesian: Mengerti, saya akan lebih teliti ke depannya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Good, I know you're capable of great work.
lines.indonesian: Baik, saya tahu Anda mampu menghasilkan pekerjaan yang bagus.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you for the encouragement, I won't let you down.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih atas dorongannya, saya tidak akan mengecewakan Anda.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I trust you. Let's move forward from here.
lines.indonesian: Saya percaya pada Anda. Mari kita lanjutkan dari sini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you, I really appreciate your patience.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, saya sangat menghargai kesabarannya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you for your time today. Let me walk you through our proposal.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih atas waktunya hari ini. Saya akan jelaskan proposal kami.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Please go ahead, we're eager to hear it.
lines.indonesian: Silakan lanjutkan, kami ingin mendengarnya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Our plan focuses on reducing costs while improving delivery time.
lines.indonesian: Rencana kami fokus pada pengurangan biaya sambil meningkatkan waktu pengiriman.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That sounds promising. What's the estimated timeline for results?
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya menjanjikan. Berapa perkiraan waktu untuk hasilnya?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: We expect to see measurable improvements within two months.
lines.indonesian: Kami perkirakan akan terlihat peningkatan yang terukur dalam dua bulan.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Impressive. We'd like to move forward with this plan.
lines.indonesian: Mengesankan. Kami ingin melanjutkan dengan rencana ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Wonderful, I'll prepare the contract for your review.
lines.indonesian: Bagus sekali, saya akan siapkan kontrak untuk Anda tinjau.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Great, when can we expect to receive it?
lines.indonesian: Baik, kapan kami bisa menerimanya?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I'll send it over by tomorrow morning.
lines.indonesian: Saya akan kirimkan besok pagi.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Perfect, our legal team will review it right away.
lines.indonesian: Sempurna, tim hukum kami akan meninjaunya segera.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Please let us know if you have any questions along the way.
lines.indonesian: Tolong beri tahu kami kalau ada pertanyaan di sepanjang prosesnya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: We will, thank you for such a clear presentation.
lines.indonesian: Akan kami lakukan, terima kasih atas presentasi yang jelas ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: It's our pleasure, we look forward to working together.
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama, kami menantikan kerja sama ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Likewise, this partnership looks very promising.
lines.indonesian: Sama, kemitraan ini terlihat sangat menjanjikan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Hi, I don't think we've met. I'm Yusuf, from the design team.
lines.indonesian: Halo, sepertinya kita belum kenal. Saya Yusuf, dari tim desain.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Nice to meet you, Yusuf. I'm Bilal, I just moved here from the branch office.
lines.indonesian: Senang berkenalan, Yusuf. Saya Bilal, baru pindah dari kantor cabang.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Welcome! How are you finding the new office so far?
lines.indonesian: Selamat datang! Bagaimana kesan Anda tentang kantor baru ini?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: It's great, everyone's been very welcoming.
lines.indonesian: Bagus sekali, semua orang sangat ramah.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Let me know if you need help settling in.
lines.indonesian: Beri tahu saya kalau butuh bantuan untuk beradaptasi.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you, I really appreciate that.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, saya sangat menghargainya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Where were you working before you transferred here?
lines.indonesian: Di mana Anda bekerja sebelum pindah ke sini?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I was at our Surabaya branch for about two years.
lines.indonesian: Saya di cabang Surabaya selama sekitar dua tahun.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's a nice city. Do you miss it much?
lines.indonesian: Itu kota yang bagus. Apakah Anda merindukannya?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: A little, but I'm excited for this new chapter here.
lines.indonesian: Sedikit, tapi saya senang dengan babak baru ini di sini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's a great attitude to have. Would you like to join us for lunch?
lines.indonesian: Itu sikap yang bagus. Mau bergabung makan siang bersama kami?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'd love to, thank you for including me.
lines.indonesian: Saya mau sekali, terima kasih sudah mengajak saya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Of course, we always welcome new faces at our table.
lines.indonesian: Tentu, kami selalu menyambut wajah baru di meja kami.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That's very kind of you, I appreciate it a lot.
lines.indonesian: Itu sangat baik dari Anda, saya sangat menghargainya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: We're having a small gathering this weekend. Would you like to come?
lines.indonesian: Kami mengadakan kumpul kecil akhir pekan ini. Mau datang?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That sounds nice. What time should I come?
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya menyenangkan. Jam berapa saya harus datang?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Around five in the afternoon, at my place.
lines.indonesian: Sekitar jam lima sore, di tempat saya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sure, should I bring anything?
lines.indonesian: Baik, apakah saya perlu bawa sesuatu?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Just yourself, we'll take care of the food.
lines.indonesian: Cukup datang saja, kami yang urus makanannya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Alright, I'll see you there. Thanks for the invitation.
lines.indonesian: Baik, sampai jumpa di sana. Terima kasih undangannya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Of course, will you be bringing anyone with you?
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama, apakah Anda akan membawa seseorang bersama Anda?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, my brother might join as well, if that's alright.
lines.indonesian: Ya, kakak saya mungkin akan ikut juga, kalau boleh.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Absolutely, the more the merrier.
lines.indonesian: Tentu saja, semakin banyak semakin seru.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Great, we'll both be there around five then.
lines.indonesian: Baik, kami berdua akan datang sekitar jam lima kalau begitu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Wonderful, I'll let the others know you're both coming.
lines.indonesian: Bagus sekali, saya akan beri tahu yang lain kalian berdua akan datang.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thanks, we're both looking forward to it.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, kami berdua sangat menantikannya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: See you both this weekend then.
lines.indonesian: Sampai jumpa kalian berdua akhir pekan ini kalau begitu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: See you soon, take care until then.
lines.indonesian: Sampai jumpa nanti, jaga diri sampai saat itu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I think there was a misunderstanding earlier. I'm sorry if I upset you.
lines.indonesian: Saya rasa ada kesalahpahaman tadi. Maaf kalau saya membuat Anda kesal.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I appreciate you saying that. I was a bit hurt by your comment.
lines.indonesian: Saya menghargai Anda mengatakan itu. Saya agak tersinggung dengan komentar Anda.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That wasn't my intention at all. Can we talk it through?
lines.indonesian: Itu sama sekali bukan maksud saya. Bisa kita bicarakan?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, I'd like that. Let's clear the air.
lines.indonesian: Ya, saya mau. Ayo kita bereskan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you for being open to talking about it.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih sudah terbuka untuk membicarakannya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course, I value our friendship too much to stay upset.
lines.indonesian: Tentu, saya terlalu menghargai persahabatan kita untuk tetap kesal.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I feel the same way, your friendship means a lot to me.
lines.indonesian: Saya merasakan hal yang sama, persahabatan kita sangat berarti bagi saya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Let's just move forward and forget about it.
lines.indonesian: Ayo kita lanjutkan saja dan lupakan soal itu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Agreed, I'll be more careful with my words next time.
lines.indonesian: Setuju, saya akan lebih hati-hati dengan kata-kata saya lain kali.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I appreciate that, I'll try to be more understanding too.
lines.indonesian: Saya menghargai itu, saya juga akan coba lebih pengertian.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you, it feels good to sort this out together.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, rasanya lega bisa membereskan ini bersama.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: It really does, I'm glad we talked.
lines.indonesian: Benar sekali, saya senang kita membicarakannya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Let's grab coffee sometime to celebrate making up.
lines.indonesian: Ayo kita minum kopi bareng suatu saat untuk merayakan berbaikan.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'd love that, let's plan it for this week.
lines.indonesian: Saya mau sekali, ayo kita rencanakan untuk minggu ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I heard you passed your certification exam. Congratulations!
lines.indonesian: Saya dengar kamu lulus ujian sertifikasi. Selamat!

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you so much, it means a lot coming from you.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih banyak, ini berarti besar datang dari kamu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: You worked so hard for it, you truly deserve it.
lines.indonesian: Kamu sudah kerja keras untuk itu, kamu benar-benar pantas mendapatkannya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That's kind of you to say. I couldn't have done it without support.
lines.indonesian: Kamu baik sekali mengatakan itu. Saya tidak bisa melakukannya tanpa dukungan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Let's celebrate together sometime soon.
lines.indonesian: Ayo kita rayakan bersama suatu saat nanti.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'd love that, when are you free this week?
lines.indonesian: Saya mau sekali, kapan kamu luang minggu ini?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: How about Friday evening, after work?
lines.indonesian: Bagaimana kalau Jumat malam, setelah kerja?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That works perfectly. Where should we go?
lines.indonesian: Itu cocok sekali. Kita ke mana?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: There's a nice new restaurant downtown, let's try it.
lines.indonesian: Ada restoran baru yang bagus di pusat kota, ayo kita coba.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sounds perfect, I'm looking forward to it.
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya sempurna, saya sangat menantikannya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: So am I, this is a great achievement worth celebrating.
lines.indonesian: Saya juga, ini pencapaian besar yang layak dirayakan.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you again for being such a supportive friend.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih lagi sudah menjadi teman yang mendukung.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's what friends are for, I'm proud of you.
lines.indonesian: Itulah gunanya teman, saya bangga padamu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That means everything to me, thank you.
lines.indonesian: Itu sangat berarti bagi saya, terima kasih.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Would you like to join us for dinner tonight?
lines.indonesian: Mau ikut makan malam bersama kami malam ini?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That's very kind, but I already have plans tonight.
lines.indonesian: Baik sekali, tapi saya sudah ada rencana malam ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: No worries at all. Maybe another time?
lines.indonesian: Tidak masalah sama sekali. Mungkin lain kali?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Definitely, I'd love to join next time.
lines.indonesian: Pasti, saya mau ikut lain kali.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Sounds good, I'll let you know when we plan the next one.
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya bagus, saya akan kasih tahu kalau kami rencanakan yang berikutnya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you for understanding, I really appreciate it.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih atas pengertiannya, saya sangat menghargainya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Of course, no pressure at all. Is everything okay tonight?
lines.indonesian: Tentu, tidak ada tekanan sama sekali. Semuanya baik-baik saja malam ini?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, I just have a family commitment I can't miss.
lines.indonesian: Ya, saya cuma ada komitmen keluarga yang tidak bisa saya lewatkan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's completely understandable, family comes first.
lines.indonesian: Itu bisa dimengerti sepenuhnya, keluarga harus diutamakan.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you for being so understanding about it.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih sudah sangat pengertian soal ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Anytime, let's plan something together next week instead.
lines.indonesian: Kapan saja, ayo kita rencanakan sesuatu bersama minggu depan sebagai gantinya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'd really like that, thank you for the offer.
lines.indonesian: Saya mau sekali, terima kasih atas tawarannya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: No problem, I'll message you to arrange the details.
lines.indonesian: Tidak masalah, saya akan kabari kamu untuk atur detailnya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sounds great, talk to you soon.
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya bagus, sampai bicara lagi nanti.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I've been feeling overwhelmed with work lately.
lines.indonesian: Saya merasa kewalahan dengan pekerjaan akhir-akhir ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you want to talk about it?
lines.indonesian: Maaf mendengarnya. Kamu mau membicarakannya?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Yes, I feel like I have too many responsibilities right now.
lines.indonesian: Ya, saya merasa punya terlalu banyak tanggung jawab sekarang.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That sounds tough. Have you thought about talking to your manager?
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya berat. Apakah kamu sudah pikirkan untuk bicara dengan atasanmu?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Not yet, but maybe I should. Thank you for listening.
lines.indonesian: Belum, tapi mungkin saya harus. Terima kasih sudah mendengarkan.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course, that's what friends are for.
lines.indonesian: Tentu, itulah gunanya teman.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: It helps just to talk about it honestly with someone.
lines.indonesian: Membantu sekali bisa membicarakannya secara jujur dengan seseorang.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I understand completely, I've felt that way before too.
lines.indonesian: Saya sepenuhnya mengerti, saya juga pernah merasakan hal itu sebelumnya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: How did you manage to get through it?
lines.indonesian: Bagaimana kamu berhasil melaluinya?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I started setting clearer boundaries at work, it really helped.
lines.indonesian: Saya mulai menetapkan batasan yang lebih jelas di tempat kerja, itu sangat membantu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's good advice, I'll try to do the same.
lines.indonesian: Itu saran yang bagus, saya akan coba lakukan hal yang sama.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Remember, it's okay to ask for help when you need it.
lines.indonesian: Ingat, tidak apa-apa untuk meminta bantuan saat kamu butuh.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you, I really needed to hear that today.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, saya sangat perlu mendengar itu hari ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Anytime, I'm always here for you.
lines.indonesian: Kapan saja, saya selalu ada untukmu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: It's been so long since we all got together. Should we plan a reunion?
lines.indonesian: Sudah lama sekali kita tidak kumpul bersama. Kita rencanakan reuni yuk?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That's a great idea. When were you thinking?
lines.indonesian: Ide yang bagus. Kapan menurutmu?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Maybe sometime next month, on a weekend?
lines.indonesian: Mungkin bulan depan, di akhir pekan?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sounds good. I'll help spread the word to the others.
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya bagus. Saya bantu sebarkan kabarnya ke yang lain.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thanks, let's find a place that works for everyone.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, ayo kita cari tempat yang cocok untuk semua orang.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: How about that restaurant we all used to go to?
lines.indonesian: Bagaimana kalau restoran yang dulu sering kita datangi?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's a great choice, it holds so many good memories.
lines.indonesian: Itu pilihan yang bagus, tempat itu penuh kenangan indah.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Exactly, everyone will love the nostalgia.
lines.indonesian: Benar sekali, semua orang akan suka nostalgianya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I'll create a group chat to coordinate the details.
lines.indonesian: Saya akan buat grup chat untuk koordinasi detailnya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Perfect, I'll help add everyone we still keep in touch with.
lines.indonesian: Sempurna, saya bantu tambahkan semua orang yang masih kita kontak.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Great, let's aim to confirm a date by this weekend.
lines.indonesian: Baik, ayo kita target konfirmasi tanggal sebelum akhir pekan ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sounds like a plan, I'm excited already.
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya cocok, saya sudah tidak sabar.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Same here, it'll be great to see everyone again.
lines.indonesian: Sama, akan menyenangkan bisa bertemu semua orang lagi.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: It really will, thanks for organizing this.
lines.indonesian: Benar sekali, terima kasih sudah mengorganisir ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: You seem a bit down today. Is everything alright?
lines.indonesian: Kamu kelihatan agak sedih hari ini. Semuanya baik-baik saja?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Not really, I've had a difficult week.
lines.indonesian: Sebenarnya tidak, saya sudah mengalami minggu yang berat.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I'm here if you want to talk about it.
lines.indonesian: Saya di sini kalau kamu mau membicarakannya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you, that means a lot to me right now.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, itu sangat berarti bagi saya sekarang.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Remember, this hard time will pass. You're not alone.
lines.indonesian: Ingat, masa sulit ini akan berlalu. Kamu tidak sendirian.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I appreciate you saying that, it does help.
lines.indonesian: Saya menghargai kamu mengatakan itu, itu membantu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Would it help to take a short walk together?
lines.indonesian: Apakah akan membantu kalau kita jalan-jalan sebentar bersama?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, that actually sounds really nice right now.
lines.indonesian: Ya, itu sebenarnya kedengarannya bagus sekarang.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Let's go, fresh air always helps clear the mind.
lines.indonesian: Ayo kita pergi, udara segar selalu membantu menjernihkan pikiran.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You're right, I already feel a little better.
lines.indonesian: Kamu benar, saya sudah merasa sedikit lebih baik.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I'm glad. We can also pray together if that helps.
lines.indonesian: Saya senang mendengarnya. Kita juga bisa shalat bersama kalau itu membantu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'd like that, it always brings me peace.
lines.indonesian: Saya mau, itu selalu membawa ketenangan bagi saya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Let's do that then, and take things one step at a time.
lines.indonesian: Ayo kita lakukan itu, dan jalani semuanya selangkah demi selangkah.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you for being such a good friend to me.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih sudah menjadi teman yang baik bagi saya.

lines.speaker: A
