lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Hi, I noticed a new feature was added. How does it work?
lines.indonesian: Halo, saya perhatikan ada fitur baru ditambahkan. Bagaimana cara kerjanya?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sure, it lets you schedule messages to send later.
lines.indonesian: Baik, fitur itu memungkinkan Anda menjadwalkan pesan untuk dikirim nanti.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's useful. How do I set the time for a scheduled message?
lines.indonesian: Itu berguna sekali. Bagaimana cara mengatur waktu untuk pesan terjadwal?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Just hold the send button and select 'Schedule Send'.
lines.indonesian: Cukup tahan tombol kirim dan pilih 'Jadwalkan Kirim'.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Got it, thank you for explaining that.
lines.indonesian: Mengerti, terima kasih sudah menjelaskan itu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You're welcome, would you like me to walk you through it live?
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama, apakah Anda mau saya pandu langsung sekarang?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Yes, please, that would be helpful.
lines.indonesian: Ya, tolong, itu akan membantu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Alright, open a chat and type your message first.
lines.indonesian: Baik, buka sebuah chat dan ketik pesan Anda dulu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Done, I've typed a message now.
lines.indonesian: Sudah, saya sudah mengetik pesan sekarang.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Great, now hold the send button until a menu appears.
lines.indonesian: Baik, sekarang tahan tombol kirim sampai muncul menu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I see the menu, and 'Schedule Send' is right there.
lines.indonesian: Saya lihat menunya, dan 'Jadwalkan Kirim' ada di sana.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Perfect, tap that and choose your preferred date and time.
lines.indonesian: Sempurna, ketuk itu dan pilih tanggal serta waktu yang Anda inginkan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: It worked, my message is now scheduled successfully.
lines.indonesian: Berhasil, pesan saya sekarang sudah terjadwal dengan sukses.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Wonderful, feel free to reach out if you need anything else.
lines.indonesian: Bagus sekali, jangan ragu hubungi kami kalau butuh yang lain.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Hi, thank you for meeting with me today about my son.
lines.indonesian: Halo, terima kasih sudah bertemu dengan saya hari ini soal anak saya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course, I'm happy to discuss his progress with you.
lines.indonesian: Tentu, saya senang membahas perkembangannya dengan Anda.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: How has he been doing in class lately?
lines.indonesian: Bagaimana perkembangannya di kelas akhir-akhir ini?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: He's doing well academically, but he's a bit quiet in group activities.
lines.indonesian: Dia baik secara akademis, tapi agak pendiam dalam kegiatan kelompok.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I see, is there something we can do to help with that?
lines.indonesian: Begitu, apakah ada yang bisa kami lakukan untuk membantu itu?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Encouraging him to join more group discussions at home could help.
lines.indonesian: Mendorongnya untuk lebih sering diskusi kelompok di rumah bisa membantu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's a good idea, we'll try that. How's his reading?
lines.indonesian: Ide bagus, kami akan coba itu. Bagaimana kemampuan membacanya?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: His reading is actually quite strong for his age.
lines.indonesian: Kemampuan membacanya sebenarnya cukup kuat untuk usianya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's great to hear, he does enjoy reading at home too.
lines.indonesian: Senang mendengarnya, dia juga suka membaca di rumah.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That definitely shows, keep encouraging that habit.
lines.indonesian: Itu terlihat jelas, terus dorong kebiasaan itu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I will. Is there anything else I should know?
lines.indonesian: Akan saya lakukan. Apakah ada hal lain yang perlu saya ketahui?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: No, overall he's a well-behaved and kind student.
lines.indonesian: Tidak, secara keseluruhan dia murid yang berperilaku baik dan ramah.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's wonderful to hear, thank you for your time today.
lines.indonesian: Senang sekali mendengarnya, terima kasih atas waktunya hari ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You're welcome, feel free to reach out anytime.
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama, jangan ragu hubungi saya kapan saja.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Hi, I'd like to enroll my daughter in your playgroup.
lines.indonesian: Halo, saya ingin mendaftarkan anak perempuan saya ke playgroup ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Wonderful, how old is she?
lines.indonesian: Bagus sekali, berapa umur dia?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: She's three years old and quite active.
lines.indonesian: Dia berusia tiga tahun dan cukup aktif.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Perfect, we have a class suited for her age group.
lines.indonesian: Sempurna, kami punya kelas yang sesuai untuk kelompok usianya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Great, what days does the class run?
lines.indonesian: Baik, hari apa saja kelasnya berlangsung?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Monday, Wednesday, and Friday mornings from nine to eleven.
lines.indonesian: Senin, Rabu, dan Jumat pagi dari jam sembilan sampai sebelas.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That works well with our schedule. What activities do they do?
lines.indonesian: Itu cocok dengan jadwal kami. Kegiatan apa saja yang mereka lakukan?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Singing, drawing, and simple social games to build confidence.
lines.indonesian: Bernyanyi, menggambar, dan permainan sosial sederhana untuk membangun kepercayaan diri.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That sounds perfect for her. What's the enrollment fee?
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya sempurna untuknya. Berapa biaya pendaftarannya?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: It's five hundred thousand rupiah per month, including materials.
lines.indonesian: Lima ratus ribu rupiah per bulan, sudah termasuk bahan-bahan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's reasonable. Can we start next Monday?
lines.indonesian: Itu wajar. Bisakah kami mulai Senin depan?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Absolutely, just bring her along with a copy of her ID.
lines.indonesian: Tentu saja, cukup bawa dia dengan fotokopi identitasnya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Understood, thank you for all the information.
lines.indonesian: Mengerti, terima kasih atas semua informasinya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You're welcome, we look forward to having her join us.
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama, kami menantikan kehadirannya bergabung dengan kami.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I think we should set a clearer bedtime for the kids.
lines.indonesian: Saya rasa kita harus menetapkan waktu tidur yang lebih jelas untuk anak-anak.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I agree, what time do you think is best?
lines.indonesian: Saya setuju, jam berapa menurutmu yang paling baik?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Maybe eight thirty on school nights.
lines.indonesian: Mungkin jam delapan setengah pada malam sekolah.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That sounds reasonable. What about weekends?
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya masuk akal. Bagaimana dengan akhir pekan?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: We could allow nine thirty on weekends.
lines.indonesian: Kita bisa izinkan sampai jam sembilan setengah di akhir pekan.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That works for me. Should we also limit screen time?
lines.indonesian: Itu cocok untukku. Apakah kita juga harus batasi waktu layar?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Yes, maybe an hour a day on weekdays.
lines.indonesian: Ya, mungkin satu jam sehari pada hari sekolah.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I think that's fair, and two hours on weekends?
lines.indonesian: Saya rasa itu adil, dan dua jam di akhir pekan?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Sounds good to me, let's write these rules down together.
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya bagus bagiku, ayo kita tuliskan aturan ini bersama.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Good idea, we can explain it to them at dinner tonight.
lines.indonesian: Ide bagus, kita bisa jelaskan ke mereka saat makan malam nanti.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Agreed, we should stay consistent once we start.
lines.indonesian: Setuju, kita harus tetap konsisten begitu mulai.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Definitely, consistency is what matters most for them.
lines.indonesian: Pasti, konsistensi adalah hal yang paling penting untuk mereka.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Let's do it together as a united front then.
lines.indonesian: Ayo kita lakukan bersama sebagai satu kesatuan yang kompak.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I like that plan, we'll tell them tonight.
lines.indonesian: Saya suka rencana itu, kita akan beri tahu mereka nanti malam.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Sweetheart, we need to talk about what happened at school today.
lines.indonesian: Sayang, kita perlu bicara tentang apa yang terjadi di sekolah hari ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I know, Mom. I shouldn't have argued with my friend.
lines.indonesian: Aku tahu, Bu. Aku seharusnya tidak berdebat dengan temanku.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Can you tell me what happened between you two?
lines.indonesian: Bisakah kamu ceritakan apa yang terjadi antara kalian berdua?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: He took my pencil without asking, so I got upset.
lines.indonesian: Dia mengambil pensilku tanpa bertanya, jadi aku jadi kesal.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I understand you were upset, but how could you handle it better?
lines.indonesian: Ibu mengerti kamu kesal, tapi bagaimana kamu bisa menanganinya lebih baik?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I could have told the teacher instead of yelling.
lines.indonesian: Aku bisa saja memberi tahu guru daripada berteriak.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Exactly, that's a much better way to solve problems.
lines.indonesian: Benar sekali, itu cara yang jauh lebih baik untuk menyelesaikan masalah.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'm sorry, Mom. I'll apologize to him tomorrow.
lines.indonesian: Maaf, Bu. Aku akan minta maaf kepadanya besok.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I'm proud of you for wanting to make it right.
lines.indonesian: Ibu bangga padamu karena mau memperbaiki keadaan.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you, Mom. I'll try to be more patient next time.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, Bu. Aku akan coba lebih sabar lain kali.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's all I ask, we all make mistakes sometimes.
lines.indonesian: Itu saja yang Ibu minta, kita semua kadang membuat kesalahan.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I understand, I'll remember this lesson.
lines.indonesian: Aku mengerti, aku akan ingat pelajaran ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Good, I love you and I'm always here to help you learn.
lines.indonesian: Baik, Ibu sayang kamu dan selalu ada untuk membantumu belajar.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I love you too, Mom, thank you for understanding.
lines.indonesian: Aku juga sayang Ibu, terima kasih sudah mengerti.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I was thinking we should visit Grandma and Grandpa this weekend.
lines.indonesian: Aku berpikir kita harus mengunjungi Kakek dan Nenek akhir pekan ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That's a good idea, it's been a while since we last visited.
lines.indonesian: Ide bagus, sudah lama sejak terakhir kita berkunjung.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Are you free on Saturday afternoon?
lines.indonesian: Apakah kamu senggang Sabtu siang?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, I'm free after twelve. What time should we go?
lines.indonesian: Ya, aku senggang setelah jam dua belas. Jam berapa kita harus berangkat?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Let's leave around one, so we arrive before they nap.
lines.indonesian: Ayo kita berangkat sekitar jam satu, supaya sampai sebelum mereka tidur siang.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Good plan, should we bring anything for them?
lines.indonesian: Rencana bagus, apakah kita harus bawa sesuatu untuk mereka?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Maybe some fruit and Grandpa's favorite biscuits.
lines.indonesian: Mungkin beberapa buah dan biskuit kesukaan Kakek.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Great idea, I'll pick those up on my way there.
lines.indonesian: Ide bagus, aku akan membelinya dalam perjalanan ke sana.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Perfect, I'll bring the kids too, they miss them a lot.
lines.indonesian: Sempurna, aku akan bawa anak-anak juga, mereka sangat rindu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Grandma will be so happy to see them.
lines.indonesian: Nenek akan sangat senang melihat mereka.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Definitely, let's plan to stay until evening.
lines.indonesian: Pasti, ayo kita rencanakan untuk tinggal sampai sore.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sounds good, I'll message you when I'm on my way.
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya bagus, aku akan kirim pesan saat aku dalam perjalanan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Perfect, see you there this Saturday then.
lines.indonesian: Sempurna, sampai jumpa di sana Sabtu ini kalau begitu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: See you then, looking forward to it.
lines.indonesian: Sampai jumpa nanti, aku menantikannya.

title: Video Call Keluarga di Luar Negeri

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Hi! It's so good to finally see your face on the call.
lines.indonesian: Halo! Senang sekali akhirnya bisa melihat wajahmu lewat panggilan ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I know, it's been a few weeks since we last talked.
lines.indonesian: Iya, sudah beberapa minggu sejak terakhir kita ngobrol.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: How's everything going over there?
lines.indonesian: Bagaimana kabar semuanya di sana?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: It's going well, though the weather has been quite cold lately.
lines.indonesian: Baik-baik saja, meskipun cuacanya cukup dingin akhir-akhir ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That sounds tough, are you staying warm enough?
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya berat, apakah kamu cukup hangat?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, I bought a thicker jacket last week.
lines.indonesian: Ya, aku beli jaket yang lebih tebal minggu lalu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Good, take care of yourself over there. How's work going?
lines.indonesian: Baguslah, jaga diri baik-baik di sana. Bagaimana pekerjaanmu?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: It's busy, but I'm learning a lot from this new project.
lines.indonesian: Sibuk, tapi aku belajar banyak dari proyek baru ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's great to hear. Everyone here misses you a lot.
lines.indonesian: Senang mendengarnya. Semua orang di sini sangat merindukanmu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I miss everyone too, I can't wait to visit next month.
lines.indonesian: Aku juga rindu semua orang, tidak sabar berkunjung bulan depan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: We're all excited to see you again in person.
lines.indonesian: Kami semua sangat senang bisa bertemu kamu lagi secara langsung.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Same here, please send my love to everyone at home.
lines.indonesian: Aku juga, tolong sampaikan salam sayangku ke semua orang di rumah.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I will, take care and let's talk again soon.
lines.indonesian: Akan aku sampaikan, jaga diri dan ayo kita ngobrol lagi segera.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sounds good, talk to you soon, I love you all.
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya bagus, sampai bicara lagi, aku sayang kalian semua.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Hi, I'd like to open a new savings account.
lines.indonesian: Halo, saya ingin membuka rekening tabungan baru.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sure, could I see your ID card and tax number please?
lines.indonesian: Baik, boleh saya lihat KTP dan nomor pajak Anda?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Here you go, both documents are ready.
lines.indonesian: Ini dia, kedua dokumennya sudah siap.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you. What type of account are you interested in?
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih. Jenis rekening apa yang Anda minati?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: A basic savings account with a debit card would be fine.
lines.indonesian: Rekening tabungan dasar dengan kartu debit sudah cukup.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Great, the minimum initial deposit is five hundred thousand rupiah.
lines.indonesian: Baik, setoran awal minimal lima ratus ribu rupiah.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's fine, I can deposit that amount now.
lines.indonesian: Itu tidak masalah, saya bisa setor jumlah itu sekarang.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Perfect, please fill out this form while I process your documents.
lines.indonesian: Sempurna, tolong isi formulir ini sementara saya proses dokumen Anda.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Sure, will I receive my debit card today too?
lines.indonesian: Baik, apakah saya akan menerima kartu debit hari ini juga?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, it will be printed and ready within thirty minutes.
lines.indonesian: Ya, akan dicetak dan siap dalam tiga puluh menit.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's quick. Can I also set up mobile banking today?
lines.indonesian: Itu cepat sekali. Bisakah saya juga aktifkan mobile banking hari ini?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course, I'll help you register once your account is active.
lines.indonesian: Tentu, saya akan bantu daftarkan setelah rekening Anda aktif.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you, I appreciate all your help today.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, saya menghargai semua bantuannya hari ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You're welcome, let's finish the paperwork now.
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama, mari kita selesaikan berkasnya sekarang.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Hi, I'm calling to check the status of my loan application.
lines.indonesian: Halo, saya menelepon untuk mengecek status pengajuan pinjaman saya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sure, may I have your application reference number?
lines.indonesian: Baik, boleh minta nomor referensi pengajuan Anda?

lines.speaker: A
lines.indonesian: Nomornya LN-2026-3391.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you, let me pull that up for you now.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, saya cek dulu untuk Anda sekarang.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Take your time, I really appreciate it.
lines.indonesian: Santai saja, saya sangat menghargainya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I see your application is currently under final review.
lines.indonesian: Saya lihat pengajuan Anda sedang dalam tahap tinjauan akhir.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I see, how much longer will that take approximately?
lines.indonesian: Begitu, kira-kira berapa lama lagi itu akan memakan waktu?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: It should be completed within three business days.
lines.indonesian: Seharusnya selesai dalam tiga hari kerja.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Alright, will I be notified once it's approved?
lines.indonesian: Baik, apakah saya akan diberi tahu setelah disetujui?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, you'll receive a text message and an email.
lines.indonesian: Ya, Anda akan menerima pesan teks dan email.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Understood, is there anything I need to prepare in the meantime?
lines.indonesian: Mengerti, apakah ada yang perlu saya siapkan sementara ini?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Not at this stage, we'll contact you if anything is missing.
lines.indonesian: Tidak untuk tahap ini, kami akan hubungi Anda jika ada yang kurang.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you for the update, I'll wait for the notification.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih atas kabarnya, saya akan tunggu pemberitahuannya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You're welcome, thank you for your patience.
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama, terima kasih atas kesabarannya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Hello, my card was retained by the ATM just now.
lines.indonesian: Halo, kartu saya tertelan mesin ATM barusan.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'm sorry to hear that. Which ATM location was it?
lines.indonesian: Mohon maaf mendengarnya. Di lokasi ATM mana itu terjadi?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: It's the one at the mall on Sudirman Street.
lines.indonesian: Yang di mal di Jalan Sudirman.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Understood. Did the transaction complete or fail before this happened?
lines.indonesian: Mengerti. Apakah transaksinya berhasil atau gagal sebelum ini terjadi?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: It failed, the screen just froze and then the card didn't come out.
lines.indonesian: Gagal, layarnya tiba-tiba macet dan kartunya tidak keluar.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I see, don't worry, we can block the card immediately for safety.
lines.indonesian: Begitu, jangan khawatir, kami bisa blokir kartunya segera demi keamanan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Yes please, block it right away.
lines.indonesian: Ya tolong, blokir segera.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Done, your card is now blocked and safe from misuse.
lines.indonesian: Selesai, kartu Anda sekarang diblokir dan aman dari penyalahgunaan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you, how can I get a replacement card?
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, bagaimana cara saya dapat kartu penggantinya?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You can visit any branch with your ID to request a new one.
lines.indonesian: Anda bisa kunjungi cabang mana saja dengan KTP untuk minta yang baru.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Alright, is there a fee for the replacement card?
lines.indonesian: Baik, apakah ada biaya untuk kartu penggantinya?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: There's a small fee of twenty-five thousand rupiah.
lines.indonesian: Ada biaya kecil sebesar dua puluh lima ribu rupiah.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's fine, I'll visit the branch tomorrow then.
lines.indonesian: Itu tidak masalah, saya akan kunjungi cabang besok kalau begitu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Perfect, thank you for reporting this quickly.
lines.indonesian: Sempurna, terima kasih sudah melaporkan ini dengan cepat.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Hi, I'd like to learn about your Shariah-compliant investment options.
lines.indonesian: Halo, saya ingin tahu tentang pilihan investasi syariah Anda.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sure, we offer Sukuk bonds and Shariah mutual funds.
lines.indonesian: Baik, kami menawarkan obligasi Sukuk dan reksadana syariah.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Could you explain the difference between the two briefly?
lines.indonesian: Bisakah Anda jelaskan singkat perbedaan keduanya?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sukuk are more stable, while mutual funds carry higher potential returns.
lines.indonesian: Sukuk lebih stabil, sementara reksadana punya potensi imbal hasil lebih tinggi.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I see, which one would suit a beginner investor better?
lines.indonesian: Begitu, mana yang lebih cocok untuk investor pemula?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'd recommend starting with Sukuk since the risk is lower.
lines.indonesian: Saya sarankan mulai dengan Sukuk karena risikonya lebih rendah.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That sounds reasonable. What's the minimum investment amount?
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya masuk akal. Berapa jumlah investasi minimalnya?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You can start with as little as one million rupiah.
lines.indonesian: Anda bisa mulai dengan hanya satu juta rupiah.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's manageable. How often are returns distributed?
lines.indonesian: Itu bisa saya jangkau. Seberapa sering imbal hasilnya dibagikan?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Returns are typically distributed quarterly.
lines.indonesian: Imbal hasil biasanya dibagikan setiap tiga bulan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Understood, I'd like to start with the Sukuk option then.
lines.indonesian: Mengerti, saya ingin mulai dengan opsi Sukuk kalau begitu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Great choice, let's fill out the application form together.
lines.indonesian: Pilihan bagus, mari kita isi formulir pengajuannya bersama.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Sounds good, thank you for the clear explanation.
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya bagus, terima kasih atas penjelasan yang jelas ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You're welcome, I'm glad I could help you decide.
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama, saya senang bisa membantu Anda memutuskan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Hello, I need to report that my debit card is missing.
lines.indonesian: Halo, saya perlu melaporkan bahwa kartu debit saya hilang.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'm sorry to hear that. When did you last have it?
lines.indonesian: Mohon maaf mendengarnya. Kapan terakhir Anda memilikinya?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I think I lost it at the market this morning.
lines.indonesian: Saya rasa hilang di pasar tadi pagi.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Understood, let's block the card right away for your safety.
lines.indonesian: Mengerti, mari kita blokir kartunya segera demi keamanan Anda.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Yes, please block it as soon as possible.
lines.indonesian: Ya, tolong blokir secepatnya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Done, your card has been blocked successfully.
lines.indonesian: Selesai, kartu Anda sudah berhasil diblokir.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you, has anyone tried to use it since this morning?
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, apakah ada yang mencoba menggunakannya sejak pagi ini?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: No suspicious transactions have been recorded so far.
lines.indonesian: Belum ada transaksi mencurigakan yang tercatat sejauh ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's a relief. How do I get a replacement card now?
lines.indonesian: Itu melegakan. Bagaimana cara saya dapat kartu penggantinya sekarang?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You can request one at any branch with your identification.
lines.indonesian: Anda bisa mengajukan di cabang mana saja dengan identitas Anda.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Alright, how long will it take to process the new card?
lines.indonesian: Baik, berapa lama proses kartu barunya?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: It usually takes about three business days.
lines.indonesian: Biasanya memakan waktu sekitar tiga hari kerja.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Understood, thank you for handling this so quickly.
lines.indonesian: Mengerti, terima kasih sudah menangani ini dengan cepat.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You're welcome, please be more careful with your card next time.
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama, tolong lebih berhati-hati dengan kartu Anda lain kali.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Hello, I'm calling about my overdue installment payment.
lines.indonesian: Halo, saya menelepon soal pembayaran cicilan saya yang terlambat.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I see, thank you for calling. How can I assist you?
lines.indonesian: Begitu, terima kasih sudah menelepon. Bagaimana saya bisa membantu Anda?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I lost my job recently and can't pay the full amount this month.
lines.indonesian: Saya baru saja kehilangan pekerjaan dan tidak bisa bayar penuh bulan ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I understand, we do offer a temporary payment adjustment option.
lines.indonesian: Saya mengerti, kami memang menawarkan opsi penyesuaian pembayaran sementara.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That would really help. What would that involve?
lines.indonesian: Itu akan sangat membantu. Apa yang termasuk di dalamnya?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: We can extend your term and lower the monthly payment slightly.
lines.indonesian: Kami bisa perpanjang jangka waktu dan sedikit turunkan pembayaran bulanan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That sounds helpful, how much lower would it be?
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya membantu, seberapa rendah nantinya?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: It would reduce from two million to one point five million rupiah.
lines.indonesian: Akan turun dari dua juta menjadi satu setengah juta rupiah.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's manageable for me right now, thank you.
lines.indonesian: Itu bisa saya jangkau saat ini, terima kasih.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You're welcome, I'll prepare the new agreement for you.
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama, saya akan siapkan perjanjian barunya untuk Anda.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I appreciate your understanding during this difficult time.
lines.indonesian: Saya menghargai pengertian Anda dalam masa sulit ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course, we want to support our customers whenever possible.
lines.indonesian: Tentu, kami ingin mendukung pelanggan kami sebisa mungkin.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you, I'll sign the new agreement as soon as possible.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, saya akan tanda tangani perjanjian barunya secepatnya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Perfect, I'll send it to your email right away.
lines.indonesian: Sempurna, saya akan kirim ke email Anda sekarang juga.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Excuse me, I'm sorry to bother you, but my car just broke down.
lines.indonesian: Permisi, maaf mengganggu, tapi mobil saya baru saja mogok.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Oh no, what happened exactly?
lines.indonesian: Aduh, apa yang sebenarnya terjadi?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: It just stopped suddenly, I think it's the engine.
lines.indonesian: Tiba-tiba berhenti begitu saja, saya rasa mesinnya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I see, do you need help pushing it to the side?
lines.indonesian: Begitu, apakah Anda butuh bantuan mendorongnya ke pinggir?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Yes, please, that would be really helpful.
lines.indonesian: Ya, tolong, itu akan sangat membantu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Alright, let's push it together to that safe spot over there.
lines.indonesian: Baik, ayo kita dorong bersama ke tempat aman di sana.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you so much, I really appreciate your help.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih banyak, saya sangat menghargai bantuannya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: No problem at all, do you have a mechanic to call?
lines.indonesian: Sama sekali tidak masalah, apakah Anda punya nomor bengkel untuk dihubungi?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Yes, I'll call one now, thank you for asking.
lines.indonesian: Ya, saya akan telepon sekarang, terima kasih sudah bertanya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Would you like me to wait with you until they arrive?
lines.indonesian: Apakah Anda mau saya menunggu bersama sampai mereka tiba?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That would be very kind of you, thank you.
lines.indonesian: Itu sangat baik dari Anda, terima kasih.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course, it's no trouble at all for me.
lines.indonesian: Tentu, itu sama sekali tidak merepotkan bagi saya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I really appreciate a stranger being this helpful.
lines.indonesian: Saya sangat menghargai orang asing yang begitu membantu ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: We should always help each other in situations like this.
lines.indonesian: Kita harus selalu saling membantu dalam situasi seperti ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Excuse me, I think I lost my wallet somewhere in this mall.
lines.indonesian: Permisi, saya rasa dompet saya hilang di suatu tempat di mal ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you remember where you last had it?
lines.indonesian: Mohon maaf mendengarnya. Apakah Anda ingat terakhir kali memilikinya?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I think it was near the food court about an hour ago.
lines.indonesian: Saya rasa itu di dekat food court sekitar satu jam lalu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Let me check our lost and found records for you.
lines.indonesian: Biar saya cek catatan barang hilang kami untuk Anda.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you, I really hope someone turned it in.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, saya sangat berharap ada yang menyerahkannya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Good news, a brown leather wallet was just brought in.
lines.indonesian: Kabar baik, dompet kulit coklat baru saja diserahkan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That sounds like mine! Can I see it to confirm?
lines.indonesian: Itu kedengarannya seperti punya saya! Bisa saya lihat untuk memastikan?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course, here it is, please check if everything's inside.
lines.indonesian: Tentu, ini dia, tolong cek apakah semuanya masih ada di dalam.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Yes, everything is here, including my ID and cash.
lines.indonesian: Ya, semuanya ada di sini, termasuk KTP dan uang tunai saya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Wonderful, please sign here to confirm you received it.
lines.indonesian: Bagus sekali, tolong tanda tangan di sini untuk konfirmasi Anda menerimanya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Of course, thank you so much for keeping it safe.
lines.indonesian: Tentu, terima kasih banyak sudah menjaganya dengan aman.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You're welcome, someone honest must have turned it in.
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama, pasti ada orang jujur yang menyerahkannya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That really restores my faith in people, thank you again.
lines.indonesian: Itu benar-benar mengembalikan kepercayaan saya pada orang lain, terima kasih lagi.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You're very welcome, have a good rest of your day.
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama sekali, semoga sisa harimu menyenangkan.

title: Melapor ke Polisi Soal Insiden Kecil

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Excuse me, officer, I'd like to report a minor traffic incident.
lines.indonesian: Permisi, Pak, saya ingin melaporkan insiden lalu lintas kecil.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Alright, can you describe what happened?
lines.indonesian: Baik, bisa Anda ceritakan apa yang terjadi?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Someone scratched my car while it was parked and drove off.
lines.indonesian: Seseorang menggores mobil saya saat sedang parkir dan langsung pergi.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I see, do you have any evidence like a photo or dashcam footage?
lines.indonesian: Begitu, apakah Anda punya bukti seperti foto atau rekaman dashcam?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Yes, I took a photo of the scratch right after it happened.
lines.indonesian: Ya, saya ambil foto goresannya segera setelah terjadi.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Good, that will help with the report. Where did this happen?
lines.indonesian: Bagus, itu akan membantu laporannya. Di mana ini terjadi?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: In the parking lot behind the shopping center on Melati Street.
lines.indonesian: Di area parkir belakang pusat perbelanjaan di Jalan Melati.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Understood, let's fill out the official report now.
lines.indonesian: Mengerti, mari kita isi laporan resminya sekarang.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Sure, will this help with my insurance claim too?
lines.indonesian: Baik, apakah ini akan membantu klaim asuransi saya juga?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, this report is exactly what your insurance company will need.
lines.indonesian: Ya, laporan ini persis yang dibutuhkan perusahaan asuransi Anda.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's good to know, how long will processing this take?
lines.indonesian: Baguslah kalau begitu, berapa lama proses ini akan memakan waktu?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You should receive a copy within the next two days.
lines.indonesian: Anda akan menerima salinannya dalam dua hari ke depan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you, officer, I appreciate your help with this.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, Pak, saya menghargai bantuannya soal ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You're welcome, I hope you get it resolved smoothly.
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama, semoga masalahnya selesai dengan lancar.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Excuse me, my friend just fell and hurt her ankle.
lines.indonesian: Permisi, teman saya baru saja jatuh dan cedera pergelangan kakinya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Alright, let me take a look. Can she move her foot at all?
lines.indonesian: Baik, biar saya periksa. Apakah dia bisa menggerakkan kakinya sedikit saja?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: A little, but it hurts a lot when she tries to stand.
lines.indonesian: Sedikit, tapi sangat sakit ketika dia coba berdiri.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: It might be a sprain, let's elevate her foot for now.
lines.indonesian: Mungkin keseleo, mari kita naikkan kakinya untuk sekarang.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Alright, should we put ice on it too?
lines.indonesian: Baik, apakah kita juga perlu kompres es?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, that would help reduce the swelling.
lines.indonesian: Ya, itu akan membantu mengurangi pembengkakan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I'll go get some ice from the nearby stall right now.
lines.indonesian: Saya akan ambil es dari kios terdekat sekarang.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Good, I'll stay here and keep her foot elevated.
lines.indonesian: Baik, saya akan tetap di sini dan menahan kakinya tetap tinggi.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you, should we take her to a clinic afterward?
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, apakah kita perlu bawa dia ke klinik setelah ini?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, it's best to have a doctor check it properly.
lines.indonesian: Ya, sebaiknya dokter yang memeriksanya dengan tepat.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Alright, I'll call a taxi once the ice is applied.
lines.indonesian: Baik, saya akan panggil taksi setelah esnya dipasang.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Good plan, she should feel a bit better after the ice.
lines.indonesian: Rencana bagus, dia seharusnya merasa lebih baik setelah dikompres es.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you so much for your quick help with this.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih banyak atas bantuan cepatnya soal ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You're welcome, I'm glad I could assist right away.
lines.indonesian: Sama-sama, saya senang bisa membantu segera.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Hey, did your power go out too? Mine just shut off.
lines.indonesian: Hei, listrikmu juga padam? Punyaku baru saja mati.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, mine did too, the whole street seems to be affected.
lines.indonesian: Ya, punyaku juga, sepertinya seluruh jalan ini terdampak.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's strange, do you know what caused it?
lines.indonesian: Aneh sekali, kamu tahu apa penyebabnya?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I heard there might be maintenance work nearby.
lines.indonesian: Aku dengar mungkin ada pekerjaan perbaikan di dekat sini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I see, do you know how long it usually takes to come back?
lines.indonesian: Begitu, kamu tahu biasanya berapa lama sampai kembali menyala?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Usually a few hours, but it can vary depending on the issue.
lines.indonesian: Biasanya beberapa jam, tapi bisa berbeda tergantung masalahnya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Alright, should we report it to the electricity company?
lines.indonesian: Baik, apakah kita harus laporkan ke perusahaan listrik?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Good idea, I have their hotline number saved on my phone.
lines.indonesian: Ide bagus, aku punya nomor hotline mereka tersimpan di ponselku.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Great, could you call them while I check on the other neighbors?
lines.indonesian: Baik, bisakah kamu telepon mereka sementara aku cek tetangga lainnya?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sure, I'll call now and let you know what they say.
lines.indonesian: Tentu, aku akan telepon sekarang dan kabari apa yang mereka katakan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thanks, I'll bring some candles just in case it takes long.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, aku akan bawa beberapa lilin kalau-kalau lama.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Good thinking, I have a few extra ones if you need them.
lines.indonesian: Pemikiran yang bagus, aku punya beberapa cadangan kalau kamu butuh.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you, let's hope it comes back on soon.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, semoga saja segera kembali menyala.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I hope so too, I'll update you once I hear back.
lines.indonesian: Aku juga berharap begitu, aku akan kabari setelah dapat jawaban.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: It's really hot today, isn't it?
lines.indonesian: Panas sekali hari ini, ya?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: It really is, I feel like it's hotter than usual.
lines.indonesian: Benar sekali, rasanya lebih panas dari biasanya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I heard it might rain later this afternoon though.
lines.indonesian: Tapi aku dengar mungkin akan hujan nanti sore.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That would be a relief, this heat is exhausting.
lines.indonesian: Itu akan melegakan, panas ini sangat melelahkan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Definitely, are you doing anything to cool down?
lines.indonesian: Pasti, apakah kamu melakukan sesuatu untuk mendinginkan diri?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I've just been drinking a lot of cold water all day.
lines.indonesian: Aku hanya banyak minum air dingin sepanjang hari.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Same here, I even brought a small fan to the office.
lines.indonesian: Sama, aku bahkan bawa kipas kecil ke kantor.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That's smart, maybe I should do that too tomorrow.
lines.indonesian: Itu pintar, mungkin aku juga harus lakukan itu besok.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: You should, it really makes a difference in this heat.
lines.indonesian: Sebaiknya begitu, itu benar-benar membantu di cuaca panas ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'll bring one tomorrow then, thanks for the tip.
lines.indonesian: Aku akan bawa satu besok kalau begitu, terima kasih atas sarannya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: No problem, hopefully the rain cools things down a bit too.
lines.indonesian: Tidak masalah, semoga hujannya juga sedikit mendinginkan suasana.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I hope so, this weather has been unpredictable lately.
lines.indonesian: Semoga begitu, cuacanya sulit ditebak akhir-akhir ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Very true, let's just hope for the best.
lines.indonesian: Benar sekali, mari kita berharap yang terbaik saja.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Agreed, at least the evening should be cooler.
lines.indonesian: Setuju, setidaknya malam harinya seharusnya lebih sejuk.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: So, what do you like to do in your free time?
lines.indonesian: Jadi, apa yang kamu suka lakukan di waktu luang?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I enjoy gardening, it helps me relax after work.
lines.indonesian: Aku suka berkebun, itu membantuku rileks setelah kerja.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That sounds peaceful. What do you grow?
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya menenangkan. Apa yang kamu tanam?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Mostly vegetables and a few flowers on my balcony.
lines.indonesian: Kebanyakan sayuran dan beberapa bunga di balkonku.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's impressive, how long have you been doing it?
lines.indonesian: Itu mengesankan, sudah berapa lama kamu melakukannya?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: About two years now, I started during the pandemic.
lines.indonesian: Sekitar dua tahun sekarang, aku mulai saat pandemi.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I see, what got you interested in it at first?
lines.indonesian: Begitu, apa yang membuatmu tertarik pada awalnya?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I just wanted a way to unwind and be productive at the same time.
lines.indonesian: Aku hanya ingin cara untuk santai dan produktif di saat bersamaan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That makes sense, what about you, do you have a hobby too?
lines.indonesian: Itu masuk akal, bagaimana denganmu, apakah kamu punya hobi juga?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Actually you didn't ask about mine yet, but I'd like to know.
lines.indonesian: Sebenarnya kamu belum tanya soal punyaku, tapi aku mau tahu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Right, sorry, I love photography, especially landscapes.
lines.indonesian: Benar, maaf, aku suka fotografi, terutama pemandangan alam.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That's wonderful, do you have a favorite place to shoot?
lines.indonesian: Itu bagus sekali, apakah kamu punya tempat favorit untuk memotret?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: The hills near my hometown, the sunrise there is beautiful.
lines.indonesian: Perbukitan dekat kampung halamanku, matahari terbitnya indah sekali.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That sounds amazing, I'd love to see some of your photos sometime.
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya luar biasa, aku ingin lihat beberapa fotomu suatu saat.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Do you have any plans for the weekend?
lines.indonesian: Kamu punya rencana untuk akhir pekan?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Not really, maybe just staying home and resting.
lines.indonesian: Tidak juga, mungkin cuma di rumah dan istirahat.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That sounds nice too. I'm thinking of visiting the botanical garden.
lines.indonesian: Itu kedengarannya bagus juga. Aku berpikir untuk mengunjungi kebun raya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Oh, that sounds fun, is it far from here?
lines.indonesian: Oh, kedengarannya seru, apakah jauh dari sini?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Not too far, about thirty minutes by car.
lines.indonesian: Tidak terlalu jauh, sekitar tiga puluh menit naik mobil.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That's manageable, would you like some company?
lines.indonesian: Itu tidak terlalu jauh, apakah kamu mau ditemani?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I'd love that, we could go Saturday morning.
lines.indonesian: Aku mau sekali, kita bisa pergi Sabtu pagi.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Perfect, should we bring anything with us?
lines.indonesian: Sempurna, apakah kita perlu bawa sesuatu?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Maybe some snacks and water for the walk.
lines.indonesian: Mungkin beberapa camilan dan air untuk berjalan-jalan.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Good idea, what time should we meet?
lines.indonesian: Ide bagus, jam berapa kita harus bertemu?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: How about eight in the morning to avoid the crowd?
lines.indonesian: Bagaimana kalau jam delapan pagi supaya hindari keramaian?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sounds good, I'll pick you up at your place then.
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya bagus, aku akan jemput kamu di tempatmu kalau begitu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Perfect, I'm really looking forward to this now.
lines.indonesian: Sempurna, aku sangat menantikan ini sekarang.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Me too, it'll be a nice break from routine.
lines.indonesian: Aku juga, ini akan jadi jeda yang menyenangkan dari rutinitas.

title: Bertanya Kabar Setelah Lama Tidak Bertemu

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Oh my goodness, it's been so long since we last met!
lines.indonesian: Ya ampun, sudah lama sekali sejak terakhir kita bertemu!

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I know, it feels like years! How have you been?
lines.indonesian: Benar, rasanya sudah bertahun-tahun! Bagaimana kabarmu?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I've been doing well, just busy with work mostly.
lines.indonesian: Aku baik-baik saja, hanya sibuk dengan pekerjaan kebanyakan.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That's good to hear, are you still working at the same company?
lines.indonesian: Bagus mendengarnya, apakah kamu masih kerja di perusahaan yang sama?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Yes, actually I just got promoted last month.
lines.indonesian: Ya, sebenarnya aku baru saja dapat promosi bulan lalu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Congratulations, that's amazing news!
lines.indonesian: Selamat, itu berita yang luar biasa!

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you so much. What about you, how's life treating you?
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih banyak. Bagaimana denganmu, bagaimana kehidupanmu?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Life's good, I actually got married last year.
lines.indonesian: Kehidupanku baik, aku sebenarnya menikah tahun lalu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Really? Congratulations, I had no idea!
lines.indonesian: Benarkah? Selamat, aku tidak tahu sama sekali!

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you, we should catch up properly sometime soon.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, kita harus benar-benar ngobrol lagi suatu saat nanti.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Definitely, are you free for coffee this weekend?
lines.indonesian: Pasti, apakah kamu senggang untuk kopi akhir pekan ini?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I am, let's meet Saturday afternoon somewhere.
lines.indonesian: Aku senggang, ayo kita bertemu Sabtu siang di suatu tempat.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Sounds perfect, I'll message you the details later.
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya sempurna, aku akan kirim pesan detailnya nanti.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Great, I really can't wait to catch up with you.
lines.indonesian: Baik, aku benar-benar tidak sabar mengobrol denganmu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I just finished reading a really interesting book last night.
lines.indonesian: Aku baru saja selesai membaca buku yang sangat menarik semalam.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Oh really? What was it about?
lines.indonesian: Oh benarkah? Ceritanya tentang apa?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: It's about a young traveler discovering different cultures.
lines.indonesian: Ceritanya tentang seorang pengembara muda yang menemukan berbagai budaya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That sounds fascinating, who's the author?
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya menarik, siapa penulisnya?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: It's written by a local author I discovered recently.
lines.indonesian: Ditulis oleh penulis lokal yang baru-baru ini aku temukan.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'd love to read it too, is it available at the bookstore?
lines.indonesian: Aku juga mau membacanya, apakah tersedia di toko buku?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Yes, I bought it at the one downtown last week.
lines.indonesian: Ya, aku membelinya di yang di pusat kota minggu lalu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Great, I'll check it out this weekend then.
lines.indonesian: Baik, aku akan lihat-lihat akhir pekan ini kalau begitu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: You should, the writing style is really engaging too.
lines.indonesian: Sebaiknya begitu, gaya penulisannya juga sangat menarik.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That's good to know, does it have a sequel?
lines.indonesian: Baguslah kalau begitu, apakah ada sekuelnya?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Yes, actually the second book comes out next month.
lines.indonesian: Ya, sebenarnya buku keduanya terbit bulan depan.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Perfect timing then, I'll finish this one before that.
lines.indonesian: Waktu yang pas kalau begitu, aku akan selesaikan yang ini sebelumnya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: We should discuss it together once you've read it.
lines.indonesian: Kita harus diskusikan bersama setelah kamu membacanya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'd really enjoy that, thanks for the recommendation.
lines.indonesian: Aku akan sangat menikmati itu, terima kasih atas rekomendasinya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Did you see the news about the new public transportation project?
lines.indonesian: Kamu lihat berita tentang proyek transportasi umum yang baru?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, I did, it sounds like a good improvement for the city.
lines.indonesian: Ya, aku lihat, kedengarannya perbaikan yang bagus untuk kota ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I agree, traffic has been really bad lately.
lines.indonesian: Aku setuju, lalu lintas sangat buruk akhir-akhir ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Definitely, hopefully this new line reduces congestion.
lines.indonesian: Pasti, semoga jalur baru ini mengurangi kemacetan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I hope so too, when is it supposed to open?
lines.indonesian: Aku juga berharap begitu, kapan rencananya dibuka?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I read it's expected to be finished by next year.
lines.indonesian: Aku baca perkiraannya selesai tahun depan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's not too far away, I'm looking forward to it.
lines.indonesian: Itu tidak terlalu lama lagi, aku menantikannya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Same here, it should really help daily commuters.
lines.indonesian: Aku juga, itu seharusnya sangat membantu para pekerja yang bolak-balik setiap hari.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Do you think you'll use it regularly once it opens?
lines.indonesian: Menurutmu kamu akan menggunakannya secara rutin setelah dibuka?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Probably, it would save me a lot of time going to work.
lines.indonesian: Kemungkinan, itu akan menghemat banyak waktuku pergi kerja.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That makes sense, I might consider it too then.
lines.indonesian: Itu masuk akal, aku mungkin akan mempertimbangkannya juga kalau begitu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: We should try it together once it's ready.
lines.indonesian: Kita harus coba bersama begitu sudah siap.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That sounds like a good plan, let's keep an eye on the updates.
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya rencana bagus, mari kita terus pantau kabar terbarunya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Agreed, I'll let you know if I hear anything new.
lines.indonesian: Setuju, aku akan kabari kalau dengar sesuatu yang baru.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Hey, would you like to go jogging with me this weekend?
lines.indonesian: Hei, kamu mau ikut jogging bareng aku akhir pekan ini?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sure, I've been wanting to start exercising more anyway.
lines.indonesian: Boleh, aku memang sudah ingin mulai lebih banyak olahraga.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Great, how about we meet at the park on Saturday morning?
lines.indonesian: Baik, bagaimana kalau kita bertemu di taman Sabtu pagi?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That works for me, what time should we meet?
lines.indonesian: Itu cocok untukku, jam berapa kita harus bertemu?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Let's say six thirty, before it gets too hot.
lines.indonesian: Bagaimana kalau jam enam setengah, sebelum terlalu panas.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Good idea, how far do you usually run?
lines.indonesian: Ide bagus, biasanya kamu lari sejauh apa?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Usually about five kilometers, but we can go slower if you'd like.
lines.indonesian: Biasanya sekitar lima kilometer, tapi kita bisa lebih pelan kalau kamu mau.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Let's start with three kilometers since I'm still a beginner.
lines.indonesian: Ayo mulai dengan tiga kilometer karena aku masih pemula.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's perfectly fine, we'll build up gradually together.
lines.indonesian: Itu tidak masalah sama sekali, kita akan tingkatkan perlahan bersama.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sounds good, should I bring anything special?
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya bagus, apakah aku perlu bawa sesuatu yang khusus?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Just comfortable shoes and a bottle of water.
lines.indonesian: Cukup sepatu yang nyaman dan sebotol air.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Got it, I'll make sure to have both ready.
lines.indonesian: Mengerti, aku akan pastikan keduanya siap.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Perfect, I'm looking forward to running together.
lines.indonesian: Sempurna, aku menantikan lari bersama.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Me too, see you Saturday morning at the park.
lines.indonesian: Aku juga, sampai jumpa Sabtu pagi di taman.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Are you planning any trips for the upcoming holiday?
lines.indonesian: Kamu berencana bepergian untuk liburan mendatang?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, I'm thinking of visiting Yogyakarta with my family.
lines.indonesian: Ya, aku berpikir untuk mengunjungi Yogyakarta dengan keluargaku.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That sounds lovely, have you been there before?
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya bagus, apakah kamu pernah ke sana sebelumnya?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Once, a long time ago, but I want to explore more this time.
lines.indonesian: Sekali, sudah lama sekali, tapi kali ini aku ingin menjelajah lebih banyak.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: What places are you planning to visit there?
lines.indonesian: Tempat apa saja yang kamu rencanakan untuk dikunjungi di sana?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Definitely the temples, and maybe some local markets too.
lines.indonesian: Pasti candi-candinya, dan mungkin beberapa pasar lokal juga.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That sounds like a great itinerary, how long will you stay?
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya rencana perjalanan yang bagus, berapa lama kamu akan tinggal?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: About five days, we want to take it slow and enjoy it.
lines.indonesian: Sekitar lima hari, kami ingin santai dan menikmatinya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's a good amount of time to really explore the city.
lines.indonesian: Itu waktu yang cukup untuk benar-benar menjelajahi kotanya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Exactly, we're also excited to try the local food there.
lines.indonesian: Benar sekali, kami juga sangat ingin mencoba makanan lokal di sana.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: You should try gudeg, it's really famous there.
lines.indonesian: Kamu harus coba gudeg, itu sangat terkenal di sana.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I've heard about it, I'll definitely try it then.
lines.indonesian: Aku sudah dengar tentang itu, aku pasti akan mencobanya kalau begitu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I hope you have a wonderful and memorable trip.
lines.indonesian: Aku harap kamu punya perjalanan yang menyenangkan dan berkesan.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you so much, I'll share some photos when I'm back.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih banyak, aku akan bagikan beberapa foto setelah kembali.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: The traffic this morning was absolutely terrible.
lines.indonesian: Lalu lintas pagi ini benar-benar parah sekali.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I know, it took me almost two hours to get to work.
lines.indonesian: Aku tahu, butuh hampir dua jam bagiku sampai ke kantor.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Same here, I feel exhausted before even starting work.
lines.indonesian: Aku juga, aku merasa lelah bahkan sebelum mulai bekerja.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: It's the same routine every single day, honestly.
lines.indonesian: Rutinitasnya sama setiap hari, sejujurnya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Have you thought about taking a different route?
lines.indonesian: Kamu sudah pikirkan untuk ambil rute yang berbeda?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I've tried, but every route seems equally congested.
lines.indonesian: Aku sudah coba, tapi setiap rute sepertinya sama macetnya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's frustrating, maybe leaving earlier could help.
lines.indonesian: Itu menjengkelkan, mungkin berangkat lebih awal bisa membantu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I might try that, waking up even earlier though.
lines.indonesian: Aku mungkin akan coba itu, walaupun harus bangun lebih pagi lagi.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I understand, it's hard to balance sleep and commute time.
lines.indonesian: Aku mengerti, sulit menyeimbangkan waktu tidur dan perjalanan.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Exactly, sometimes I wish I could work from home instead.
lines.indonesian: Benar sekali, kadang aku berharap bisa kerja dari rumah saja.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Have you asked your manager about that option?
lines.indonesian: Kamu sudah tanya manajermu soal opsi itu?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Not yet, but I'm thinking about bringing it up soon.
lines.indonesian: Belum, tapi aku sedang pertimbangkan untuk membicarakannya segera.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's a good idea, it could really improve your daily life.
lines.indonesian: Itu ide bagus, itu bisa benar-benar memperbaiki kehidupan sehari-harimu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I hope so, this routine is really wearing me down.
lines.indonesian: Aku berharap begitu, rutinitas ini benar-benar membuatku lelah.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I heard you finally finished your master's degree, congratulations!
lines.indonesian: Aku dengar kamu akhirnya menyelesaikan gelar magistermu, selamat!

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you so much, it's been a long journey.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih banyak, itu perjalanan yang panjang.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I can imagine, how long did it take you in total?
lines.indonesian: Aku bisa bayangkan, berapa lama total waktunya?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: About two and a half years while working full time.
lines.indonesian: Sekitar dua setengah tahun sambil bekerja penuh waktu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That's really impressive, balancing both must have been hard.
lines.indonesian: Itu benar-benar mengesankan, menyeimbangkan keduanya pasti berat.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: It really was, but I'm glad I pushed through it.
lines.indonesian: Memang berat, tapi aku senang bisa bertahan menyelesaikannya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: You should be proud of yourself, that's a big achievement.
lines.indonesian: Kamu harus bangga pada dirimu sendiri, itu pencapaian besar.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you, it means a lot to hear that from you.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, itu sangat berarti mendengarnya darimu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Are you planning to use this degree for a new career path?
lines.indonesian: Apakah kamu berencana menggunakan gelar ini untuk jalur karier baru?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, I'm actually considering a move into research.
lines.indonesian: Ya, aku sebenarnya mempertimbangkan pindah ke bidang riset.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That sounds exciting, I wish you the best of luck.
lines.indonesian: Kedengarannya menarik, aku doakan yang terbaik untukmu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you, I really appreciate your support through all this.
lines.indonesian: Terima kasih, aku sangat menghargai dukunganmu selama ini.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Of course, we should celebrate this achievement properly.
lines.indonesian: Tentu saja, kita harus rayakan pencapaian ini dengan layak.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'd love that, let's plan something this weekend.
lines.indonesian: Aku mau sekali, ayo kita rencanakan sesuatu akhir pekan ini.
